name: v1.4.247
body:
## Improved Chat UI, richer phone reviews & more ways to make Orca yours ✨

- 🔄 **Continue after usage limits reset:** An optional setting resumes your chat automatically when its usage limit resets.
- 📱 **Richer reviews on your phone:** Browse branch commits, jump between files in diffs, and read or add pull-request review comments alongside the code.
- 🎨 **Make Orca yours:** Discover more themes, preview fonts in their own typefaces, and import Ghostty or Kitty configuration files.
- 🧩 **More powerful plugins:** Build custom editors, live status items and panels, and connect plugins to agent prompts, launches and workspace actions.
- 🤝 **Clearer agent activity:** Running workers stay visible after their coordinator finishes, with easier account switching and clearer hand-off cards.
- ⚡ **Smoother everyday work:** Fewer unnecessary redraws and offscreen animations, more reliable saved replies, and fixes for workspaces, terminals and emulator previews.
- 💬 **Improved Chat UI:** Choose Chat or CLI for each agent in Chat UI settings, keep drafts when continuing from a terminal, and see your selected permission mode clearly.

## Highlights

- **Chat UI:** Choose Chat or CLI for each agent directly in Chat UI settings. Permission choices stay visible, model and effort controls remain usable while options refresh, and focusing the composer keeps open overlays in place.
- **Conversation continuity:** Keep unsent text when moving from a terminal into chat, and preserve received replies and tool results while saving is busy. Turn on automatic continuation to resume a chat after its usage limit resets.
- **Phone source control:** Review each branch commit on its own page, jump between files, fold diff context, and read or add review comments alongside the code. The pull-request tab focuses on what blocks the merge, with clearer next actions and automatic refreshes.
- **Themes & fonts:** Find GitHub, VS Code and catalog themes in the appearance controls. Preview each font in its own typeface, import Ghostty themes with light/dark pairs, and bring in Kitty configuration files too.
- **Plugins:** Create custom editors that keep pending edits through saves and reloads, live status bar items, and component panels with a Box layout container. Hooks connect plugins to agent launches, prompts, tool calls, terminal sends and workspace creation; screenshot and testing tools help check the result.
- **Agents & orchestration:** Running workers remain in the Agents list after their coordinator finishes. Hand-off cards make delegated work easier to follow, and Codex and Claude account switchers are simpler to use.
- **Remote work & workspaces:** Preview remote HTML outside registered workspaces, find projects in stopped WSL distros after a restart, and see clearer Git progress. Child worktrees stay in the caller’s project, folder roots remain visible, and branch links open the current pull request.
- **Responsiveness & reliability:** Offscreen animations pause, unrelated settings changes cause fewer diff redraws, and unused editor models are released. Terminal fixes prevent stray escape text, while emulator previews offer clearer connection and startup feedback.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Chat or CLI per agent:** Chat UI is out of Experimental. Shared launch controls are also available in Settings → Chat UI, so you can choose which surface each agent opens.
- **Automatic continuation is optional:** Enable it if you want a usage-limited chat to continue automatically after the limit resets.
- **Phone Send behavior:** The phone follows the paired desktop’s send setting. Update Orca Mobile as well as your desktop or server to get the mobile changes.
- **Orchestration panel:** The experimental Orchestration panel is disabled while its app-wide lag is addressed. Orchestration commands continue to work.

## Known issues

**Saved chat storage:** Chat history can continue to use more disk space as conversations grow; automatic storage compaction is not included in this release.

**Plugin command replacements:** A plugin replacing a built-in command can still finish after Orca has used the normal command instead, causing the action to happen twice.

---

name: v1.4.246
body:
## Orchestrator V3, improved terminal, Chat UI out of experimental & a refreshed phone app ✨

- 🤝 **Orchestrator V3:** A lot more token efficient and reliable. Works with both CLI agents and Chat UI, with visual worker indicators in Chat UI to help you follow progress.
- 🔕 **Quieter notifications:** Orca now filters out worker agent notifications during orchestration.
- 📱 **A refreshed Orca Mobile:** Choose **Light, Dark or System** and pick your **display language** in Settings. Enjoy cleaner screens, smoother sheets and faster workspace lists.
- 💬 **Chat UI is out of experimental:** Choose Chat or CLI for each agent, queue follow-ups while it works, and continue with another account or agent harness when you hit a usage limit.
- ⌨️ **Improved terminals:** Faster input for terminal agents, more reliable session restores, and fixes for text rendering, links and padding.
- 🎨 **Make Orca yours:** Choose an editor theme independently of the app, add a background image, or match the whole window to your terminal theme.
- 🧩 **Explore community plugins:** Browse the community catalog, try syntax themes, and build your own panels with TypeScript and TSX.
- 🖱️ **Improved computer use & browser use:** More reliable background browsing, sign-in popups, uploads and downloads, plus computer-use fixes on Windows and Linux.

## Highlights

- **Mobile theme & language pickers:** Pick **Light, Dark or System** for the phone app and choose your **display language** in Settings → Appearance and Language.
- **A refreshed phone app:** A Home screen focused on what needs you, compact top bars, bottom search, filter chips, clearer lists and smoother sheets. Workspace lists load with less data, images and Mermaid diagrams support pinch-to-zoom, and iOS can show inline HTML cards and previews. Run automations from your phone too.
- **Plugins:** The community catalog is visible by default, with public install counts and clearer publisher information. Plugin authors get TypeScript and TSX without a separate build step, component-based panels, worker communication, hot reload and CLI tools for testing and screenshots.
- **Chat UI:** Chat leaves Experimental. Choose Chat or CLI in each agent’s Settings row, with default model and effort choices. Follow-up messages queue by default while an agent works; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends one straight into the running turn. Switch accounts for open chats, or continue a usage-limited conversation with another account or agent harness.
- **Themes & editors:** Set a separate code editor theme, tune editor typography, use background images, and apply Match Terminal across the whole window. Preview SVG source alongside the image, click to zoom images and Alt-drag to pan.
- **Source Control:** Resolve conflicts and complete merges on desktop or phone. Open every changed file from the mobile diff screen, return a pull request to draft from a paired phone, and refresh checks and reviews with current provider data.
- **Browser & computer use:** Agents can work with sign-in and payment popups, upload through file-picker buttons in nested frames, answer page dialogs and save downloads to the requested path. Background browser pages stay active while agents use them.
- **Orchestrator V3:** A lot more token efficient and reliable. Coordinators end their turn and wake when workers report back, with shorter CLI status and inbox output. It works great in Chat UI, where visual worker cards and activity indicators help you follow progress. Give finished workers follow-up tasks and reopen closed workers.
- **Everyday speed & polish:** Less whole-app hitching with many chats, quicker shell submissions, faster worktree checkout, and fewer redraws in chats and diffs. Child agents start collapsed, with idle agents grouped together on desktop and phone.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Chat or CLI per agent:** Chat UI no longer needs the Experimental switch. Existing users keep their launch preferences and existing conversations keep their surface. New installs start in Terminal. Choose Chat or CLI and the default model and effort in Settings → Agents.
- **Follow-ups queue by default:** While an agent works, Enter queues your next message. Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends it into the running turn instead. Turn off **Queue follow-ups** in Settings → Chat → Behavior to change the default. On a phone, hold Send to choose Queue or Steer. The phone follows its host’s setting; older clients or hosts without queue support keep sending immediately.
- **Mobile app updates:** Native Settings changes, including the theme and language pickers, require an updated mobile app. Update Orca Mobile as well as your desktop or server to get the full experience.
- **Plugin trust & updates:** Orca warns before trusting non-official plugins. Updates that request more access wait for individual review, and installed plugin content is verified again when loaded.
- **Isolated desktop plugin views:** Plugin panels and custom editors now use separate processes and storage with direct network access blocked. Browser and serve clients retain their existing iframe behavior.
- **WSL hosts:** Stopped distros stay stopped when restoring or switching workspaces, and blocked panes offer Start. Turning the WSL hosts setting off stops new hosts and moves while saved hosts keep serving. Idle WSL servers can exit after five minutes without putting that idle timeout in your own shells.
- **Orca skills:** Unedited bundled skills update automatically. Skills you have changed still prompt for review.

---

## Product experience

### Terminals

*Quicker prompt submission, more reliable restores and fixes for text weight, links, padding and Windows startup errors.*

* Bound the in-process macOS process table's blocking calls and ps fallbacks (#31783) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36282

* Link a URL wrapped inside a table cell on every row by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36482
* Skip the ConPTY input-reader check on WinPTY panes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36490

* Add Chat UI upgrade tip and Chat/Terminal default tiles by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36171

name: v1.4.245
body:
## A faster Orca, plugins & background computer use ⚡

- ⚡ **A faster Orca:** Launch smoothly with hundreds of chats, with less lag as you type and switch tabs.
- 🧩 **Customize Orca** with icon themes, syntax highlighting and custom editors.
- 🖱️ **Keep working** while agents use Chrome, Blender and other Mac apps in the background.
- 🎙️ **Dictate on your phone** and see your words as you speak.
- 💬 **Try the new Chat UI:** Search for “Chat UI” in Settings to turn it on, then right-click a tab to switch live between Chat UI and TUI.

## Highlights

- **A faster Orca:** Fast app with hundreds of chats. Typing stays more responsive, and hidden chats do less work while you use other tabs.
- **Plugins:** Add icon themes, syntax highlighting and custom editors from Settings → Plugins. Community publishing is coming soon, so you’ll be able to share your own plugins.
- **Background computer use on Mac:** Let agents work in Chrome, Blender and other apps while you keep using your mouse and keyboard. Orca’s in-app browser already works in the background; now computer use does too. Some actions still need the app brought forward.
- **Chats:** Enjoy a very polished Chat UI, send again after Stop, and preview links in chat. Search for “Chat UI” in Settings to turn it on, and right-click a tab to switch live between Chat UI and TUI.
- **Terminals:** Set a running terminal limit for each computer in Settings → Terminal → Advanced.
- **WSL:** Stopped distros stay stopped until you choose Start. Terminals remember their folder.
- **Browser:** Press Cmd+Opt+B on Mac for a browser split. Send shorter annotation feedback, now with pasted images.
- **Workspaces:** Your workspace name becomes its branch name again. Source Control actions get Model and Effort controls.
- **Phone:** See dictation as you speak, and read clearer code, tables and diagrams.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **New terminal host:** This release starts a fresh terminal host for new terminals. Terminals already open before the update keep running on the previous host and stay attached. The new running terminal limit setting needs the new host, and so do fixes such as the ble.sh startup fix and lighter process checks on macOS. Those apply to terminals you open after updating.
- **Plugins are on by default:** Installing a plugin, including from an `orca://plugins` link, only opens a review screen first. Plugins that run code ask for your consent before they install, and once approved they run with full access to your computer.
- **Running terminal limit:** The default now follows each computer: half of its system terminal limit, up to 4096, or 256 as before when Orca can’t read that limit. A value you set in Settings or with an environment variable takes priority. Raising or lowering it never closes running terminals. A remote server running an older Orca keeps working, but the limit can’t be changed there until it updates.
- **Chat naming:** Chats are now named by their own agent and account by default. A naming agent, custom command or arguments you saved before keep working, and the naming agent choice moved under Advanced in Settings → Chat → Chat naming.
- **Codex history across accounts:** A new switch, Settings → Agents → Share Codex history across accounts, is on by default and keeps today’s behavior. With it on, history from Orca’s managed accounts now also shows up in your own ~/.codex when you switch back to system default. Turning it off stops new sharing and removes nothing. On an SSH or WSL host running an older Orca, the switch stays disabled until that host updates.
- **Codex on macOS and Linux:** Orca now starts Codex with its paste guess turned off, so prompts typed from a phone or another client send instead of staying in the composer. Real pastes still arrive as pastes.
- **Computer use on a Mac:** Agents now act in the background by default. Agents can still ask for the old foreground mode with `--restore-window`, which drags into Chromium and Electron apps still need.
- **Browser annotations:** Send and Copy now give agents a short summary per note. Check **Include page details** in the Send menu to get the old full output; the choice lasts for that browser pane.
- **Workspace branch names:** A name you type for a new workspace is used as its branch again, even when Auto-rename branch from work is on. Auto-rename only replaces names Orca made up.
- **Automations:** Agents started by an automation skip their CLI’s startup update prompt, so the prompt can’t swallow the task. Agents you start yourself are unchanged.
- **Source Control actions:** Model and effort flags saved in an action’s Arguments move into the new Model and Effort controls when Orca loads; other Arguments stay as they are. A phone or remote server on an older Orca may launch these actions with a different model or effort until it updates.
- **New shortcuts:** Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+X opens Plugins (outside text fields), and Cmd+Opt+B on macOS opens a browser tab in a split to the right. Cmd+Opt+B can be changed in Settings → Keyboard.
- **Known limitation, downgrading:** If you go back to v1.4.244, custom model and effort choices on Source Control AI actions reset to the agent’s defaults, and updating again won’t bring them back.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat

*No more startup freeze with many chats, link previews, naming with the chat’s own agent, and a working Send after Stop.*

* Show chats as Interrupted or Done at startup without reading their history, so Orca no longer freezes after launch with hundreds of chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32146
* Show hover cards for GitHub PR and issue links in chats by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35199
* Show preview cards for web links in chats, never fetching private network addresses by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35221
* Name each chat with its own agent and account by default, with other naming agents under Advanced by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32106
* Let the next message go through after Stop force-kills a chat’s agent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34653
* Keep a huge unbroken paste from freezing a chat by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36031
* Run launcher Commands like `op run -- codex` for every agent in chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35592
* Leave Claude plan mode when you approve a plan by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34549
* Resume a chat with a saved effort on Claude Code versions that predate --effort by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35878
* Keep the model options a chat accepted in what it shows and sends by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31208
* Keep a chat’s option controls working while its model list refreshes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31927
* Handle large pastes in chat goal mode by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34654
* Order queued chat turns without rescanning the transcript by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34945
* Stop resting chats from delaying native command menus by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35069
* Recover from OpenCode failures in chats by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35247
* Keep models missing from a provider’s list available in chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35266

name: Orca Mobile Android mobile-android-v0.0.61
body:
Thank you for using Orca mobile! ❤️

## What's new

- **The app speaks your language.** Orca mobile is now available in German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
- **A new terminal keyboard.** Agent tabs use the chat composer, and shell tabs type straight into the terminal. The key row has a Ctrl key that stays on for the next key and an arrow pad, and every text box in the app now looks like the chat composer.
- **Better dictation.** Your words show up as you speak and go in at the cursor. A voice meter and timer show while you talk, and dictation keeps going through a dropped connection.
- **Finish merges from your phone.** Resolve conflicted files and complete a merge in Source Control.
- **Richer chat.** Images from your computer show inline, and code, tables, quotes and diagrams are easier to read.
- **A new iPhone Duo layout.** Terminal keys and a D-pad sit in the side strip, and you can show two terminals side by side.
- **Alerts without push.** Phones without push notifications still get agent alerts while Orca is open and connected.
- Faster reconnects after a dropped connection, more reliable terminal input and long pastes, and fixes for Markdown editing, agent question cards, and Shift+Enter on iOS keyboards.

Most phone features come from your desktop, so update Orca on your computer to get everything. See the [desktop release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) for the full list.

name: v1.4.244
body:
## Faster diff view and editor, more languages, and better remote files 🌍

This release adds four interface languages, makes switching workspaces faster by preparing the one you’re about to open, and lets files on SSH hosts and paired servers play, save and open like local ones. It also brings smoother chat streaming, a faster prompt in new Windows terminals, steadier WSL terminals, and many fixes for dictation on the phone.

## The short version

- **Four new languages:** German, Russian, Turkish and Traditional Chinese join the language picker, and many more dialogs, menus and shortcuts are translated. German is machine-translated, and reviews from native speakers are welcome.
- **Faster workspace switching:** Hovering a workspace in the sidebar gets it ready, the workspaces next to the current one stay warm, and the switch itself does less work. Dragging a row never switches.
- **Remote files that work like local ones:** Play audio and video from SSH hosts and paired servers, save remote text files up to 50 MB, open folders too big for one reply as you scroll, and never open a remote binary as text.
- **Smoother chats:** Long replies stream with less stutter, @file suggestions keep up in large repositories, and multi-agent Codex chats no longer grow the local chat history to gigabytes. Claude chats can rewind to before your first message.
- **Steadier terminals:** New Windows terminals show their prompt right away instead of after about 3 seconds, closing or resizing a terminal no longer freezes the others on macOS and Linux, and WSL terminals keep their session and folder when their distro stops.
- **Browser:** Clear Google cookies from a profile when Google sign-in is stuck on an old account, import cookies from Vivaldi, and Orca no longer quits at startup on Windows and Linux when an extension’s helper window closes.
- **Fixes from the community:** Kimi K3 for commit messages, Devin Desktop in Open In, highlighting for Glimmer, CUDA, Groovy and shebang scripts, `orca worktree create --branch`, `~` in the worktree location, MacPorts tools on macOS, and the faster Windows prompt.

**Phone & web updates:** Dictation on the phone keeps recording through a reconnect, keeps your words through calls and busy taps, gives your audio back when it stops, and explains setup before asking for the microphone. The mobile setup page now sends iPhone installs to the App Store. Korean 10-Key typing, held terminal keys, pairing and file saves on the phone work better, and the phone does less work in the background.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Same terminal host as v1.4.243:** This release keeps v1.4.243’s terminal host instead of starting a fresh one, so terminals open when you update keep running and stay attached. A few terminal fixes run inside the terminal host, such as the faster prompt in new Windows terminals, closing or resizing a terminal without freezing others, and Ctrl+C in Codex. They take effect once the terminal host restarts, for example after you restart your computer.
- **SSH hosts and paired servers:** Some remote fixes need the host’s Orca server on this version too: saving large files, opening very large folders, theme answers for Codex in paired terminals, and copying from Codex started by hand (open a new remote shell after the host updates). Older servers keep their current behavior.
- **SSH workspaces:** Deleting a workspace on an SSH project now offers **Remove from Orca**, which leaves its files on the host untouched.
- **Workspace switching:** Workspaces still switch on click. Holding the next or previous workspace shortcut (Cmd+Shift+Up/Down) now moves the sidebar highlight and switches once you let go.
- **Worktree location:** A location starting with `~` now means your home folder. A `~` value saved by an earlier version is expanded on the next start.
- **Word separators:** Double-click always breaks words at spaces and tabs, even if your custom Word Separators setting leaves them out. The saved setting doesn’t change.
- **Mobile setup:** The iOS button, QR code and copied link on the mobile setup page point to the App Store. The TestFlight preview option is gone; Android still uses the APK link.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Smoother streaming, chat history that stays small, and Claude rewind from the first message.*

* Stream long chat replies with less stutter by parsing each block once by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34821
* Reuse typeset equations while chat replies stream by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34819
* Keep @file suggestions and Quick Open up with your typing in large repositories by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34820
* Stop multi-agent Codex chats from growing the local chat history to gigabytes and freezing the next launch by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35226
* Rewind a Claude chat to before your first message by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34239
* Show a chat’s saved permission mode, and let you change it, while its agent isn’t running by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34546
* Edit queued messages in place with the full chat composer, including images, skills and @files, on desktop and phone by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31180
* Show Hand Off in a chat tab’s top-right header, as terminals do by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34544
* Show pasted images as thumbnails you can enlarge in terminal-backed chats by @lurunzi in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22328
* Show and open `file:` images, and host images outside the workspace, in chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31781
* List OMP skills in the / menu as /skill:<name> by @pandudpn in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31999
* Show the full date and time when you hover a message’s timestamp by @VictorVow in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32051
* Close the chat naming error card when you open Settings from it by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34655
* Cut the work every open chat does on each update, easing lag with many chats by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34755
* Skip chat status rechecks when only the sidebar’s sort order changes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34781
* Keep rows the host removed out of chats on desktop and phone by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34996
* Say a chat’s working folder was deleted, instead of saying its CLI is missing by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35003
* Say when Orca couldn’t prepare a chat’s start, with the host’s error in Details by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35186
* Show a pending approval’s Allow and Deny on remote and phone clients after brief read failures by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35339

### Browser

*Clear Google cookies, import from Vivaldi, and browser and extension cleanup that frees memory.*

* Clear Google cookies from a browser profile in Settings, to fix a Google sign-in stuck on an old account by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34158

name: Orca Mobile Android mobile-android-v0.0.60
body:
Thank you for using Orca mobile! ❤️

## What's new

- **Light and dark themes.** The app follows the same colour palettes as desktop.
- **Phone and desktop behave the same.** The workspace list, Source Control, pull requests, chat cards, terminal paste and links now follow the same rules as the desktop app, so what you see on the phone matches your computer.
- **Copy from chat.** Code blocks and shell commands in chat have a copy button.
- **Reorder queued messages** by dragging them, on the phone and on desktop.
- **iPhone Duo support**, folded and unfolded, with controls in its side status bar.
- **Open PDFs** from the file browser in the system viewer.
- **Smoother chat.** Streaming replies and typing no longer redraw the whole chat, and long chats scroll more smoothly.
- **More reliable dictation.** Dictated words survive calls and failed inserts, the app explains setup before asking for the microphone, and it says why dictation failed.
- An unreachable computer shows why instead of an endless spinner, and pairing shows its progress and errors even without camera access.
- Fixes for terminal typing and scrolling, Korean 10-Key input, Android Back, and tabs and workspaces after your computer restarts.

Most phone features come from your desktop, so update Orca on your computer to get everything. See the [desktop release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) for the full list.

name: v1.4.243
body:
## Chrome extensions in Orca’s browser, iPhone Duo support, and Convert a terminal agent session live into a chat ui 🧩

This release brings Chrome extensions to Orca’s browser under experimental, lets a conversation continue in Chat once you quit its agent in the terminal, and shows your local worktrees sooner after a restart. It also adds support for the folding iPhone Duo, compact native-style menus, light and dark themes on the phone, and fixes for Windows terminals, SSH hosts and updates.

## The short version

- **Chrome extensions (experimental):** Add extensions from the Chrome Web Store with **Add to Orca**, so password managers like Bitwarden and 1Password can fill logins in Orca’s browser. Off by default.
- **Convert a terminal agent session live into a chat ui:** Once you quit Claude or Codex in a terminal, the same conversation can continue in Chat while the terminal tab stays open. Claude chats also keep their saved approval choice across model changes, and closing a chat that’s still working asks first.
- **Worktrees sooner after a restart:** Local worktrees load before terminals restore, and the sidebar says discovery is still running instead of showing an empty list.
- **Steadier terminals:** Windows terminals keep their history through width changes, slept terminals wake in the folder you left, macOS’s built-in bash keeps command tracking in order after a DEBUG trap change, and copying from pi on a remote host reaches your clipboard.
- **Orchestration:** Choose the worker heartbeat interval or turn heartbeats off, and reduce CPU use by stopping settled workers from polling for commands.
- **Polish where it counts:** Compact native-style menus, VS Code–style Markdown highlighting with sticky headings, and update checks through your Settings proxy.
- **Fixes from the community:** Quit and Stop All Sessions, math in chats, Copy Remote URL with line ranges, IME highlighting in terminals, fnm on Windows, and Japanese and Chinese translations all work better.

**Phone & web updates:** Phones get light and dark themes, support for the folding iPhone Duo, PDFs in Quick Look and copy buttons in chats. Many phone screens now follow desktop’s rules for chats, Source Control and terminals, and typing and scrolling in long chats stay fast.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Fresh terminal host:** New terminals start on a fresh terminal host so this release’s terminal fixes apply, including continuing a chat after its terminal agent exits. Terminals already open before you update keep running, and stay attached, on the previous host until you close them.
- **Browser extensions (experimental):** Turn on **Settings → Experimental → Browser extensions**, restart, then open the Chrome Web Store in an Orca browser tab. Extensions run in local browser profiles only. Ad blockers install but don’t block yet, and some extensions, such as Tampermonkey, don’t work.
- **Worker heartbeats:** Heartbeats stay on every 5 minutes by default. Changes in **Settings → Agent Orchestration** apply to newly dispatched workers; workers already running keep their brief, and older hosts keep 5 minutes.
- **Claude subagent navigation:** The eye that marked the subagent you’re viewing is gone. The viewed subagent row uses the normal current-row highlight.

---

## Product experience

### Browser

*Chrome extensions under experimental, cookie imports that keep you signed in, and agent clicks that land.*

* Install Chrome extensions, such as password managers, from the Chrome Web Store into Orca’s browser (experimental, off by default) by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30940
* Import cookies without signing the browser out of sites by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34113
* Show cookie import as available in Browser Use settings before skill setup by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34097
* Say when secret-tool is missing on Linux cookie import instead of blaming the keyring by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34099
* Scroll off-screen elements into view before agent clicks and hovers by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34262
* Deliver agent clicks and keys to pages that loaded while their pane was hidden by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34291
* Paste your local clipboard into streamed browser pages by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34269
* Copy and cut from streamed browser pages to your local clipboard by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34290
* Ship the browser automation helper’s skill guides with desktop builds by @zerone0x in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/17714
* Keep an Annotate session going when the page loads an iframe by @Brant-lzh in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24032
* Remove a deleted server’s browser data without a Windows “resource busy” error by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33280
* Open HTML preview links in your preferred browser, honoring modifier keys by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33622

### Native chat (experimental)

*Continue in Chat after the terminal agent exits, keep Claude’s approval choice, and type with less lag.*

* Continue a conversation in Chat once its terminal agent has exited, while the terminal tab stays open by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33759

### Agent launch, status & accounts

*Antigravity usage that explains itself, restored agents that take startup answers, and calmer subagent rows.*

### SSH, WSL & remote servers

*SSH hosts that move with their automations, host files outside workspaces, and WSL distros that stop when idle.*

name: v1.4.242
body:
## Lighter on memory, Claude subagents a click away, and remote servers that remember 🪄

This release is lighter on memory, with lower memory use in the terminal host and WSL connections, plus less idle CPU use in terminals. It also lets you open Claude subagents straight from the sidebar, makes Codex chats in Ask mode ask before editing, and helps paired servers, SSH and WSL hosts keep your tabs and explain failures. This release also fixes problems across Windows, Linux and macOS.

## The short version

- **Open Claude subagents from the sidebar:** Click a Claude subagent row in the sidebar or dashboard to open its transcript in the same terminal, then click the parent to go back. An eye marks the one you’re viewing.
- **Chats that ask first:** Codex chats in Ask mode now ask before editing your workspace, remote Claude terminals on paired servers can continue in Chat, and chats that can’t start tell you why.
- **Agents resume as you left them:** Resumed Claude sessions keep their effort level and launch flags, Codex keeps the permission you last gave it, and Session History finds chats in more folders and on servers.
- **Remote servers that remember:** Paired servers keep your tabs across restarts, closed tabs stay closed, WSL hosts stop re-pairing after each restart, and SSH failures say what actually went wrong.
- **Lighter on memory:** Terminals use far less idle CPU, the terminal host uses less memory once it next restarts, WSL connections need much less memory, and the resource panel now matches Activity Monitor on macOS.
- **Fixes from the community:** Spaced Windows launcher paths, Korean input, DST in automations, focus-follows-mouse, tab dragging and Linux packages all work better.

**Phone & web updates:** Phones now explain an unreachable computer instead of spinning forever, and streaming replies and long web chats redraw less. Terminal programs that ask the terminal a question also keep working while a phone watches at desktop size.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Codex chats in Ask mode:** Ask now runs read-only and asks before workspace edits; Approve for me and Full access are unchanged, and work already running keeps its grant. Chats on a paired server keep the old behavior until that server is updated.
- **Claude subagent navigation:** On by default with Claude status hooks. Orca loads its plugin only into Orca panes and adds one shortcut, the first free of Ctrl+Alt+G, H or V, to `keybindings.json` in each Claude folder it uses. Turn it off in Settings → Agents → Claude subagent navigation to remove that shortcut. Claude sessions already running need a fresh launch.
- **Paired servers:** Moving a pane into a new tab and continuing a remote Claude terminal in Chat need the server to run this release. On older servers the move stays in this window only, as before, and Continue in Chat UI shows disabled with an update hint.
- **Claude account switching:** Switching accounts now also offers to restart sessions running in your System default Claude folder when that folder is signed in to the old account. The dialog groups sessions into those on the old account, others, and ones it can’t move.
- **WSL hosts:** Connections to a WSL host’s server now go through bash and fall back to Node when bash is missing or too old. This needs no server update and works with any server version.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Codex asks before editing, remote terminals continue in Chat, and chats that can’t start say why.*

* Ask before Codex workspace edits in Ask mode, and apply permission changes to each fresh turn by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31299
* Continue remote Claude terminal conversations in Chat on paired servers, from the pane or Session History by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33954
* Send launch prompts and worker tasks through the retrying start so a first failed start doesn’t lose them by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33832
* Show a start failure after one try when the agent’s answer can never succeed on a retry by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33685
* Say why Claude refused to start a chat, including Full access while running as root by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33812
* Make Stop pause Codex goal work, and start Set and Resume with the composer’s saved model and effort by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33631
* Give a chat a fresh automatic name after /clear, while keeping names you set by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32287
* Show chat-only workspaces as active before the first message by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33815
* Keep a Pi chat open when Pi sends an event over 8 MiB, such as a large inline image by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33651
* Remove the usage-limit Continue button that could hit the same limit again by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33392
* Keep link and file actions in a chat context menu reopened right after another by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33725
* Keep retained chat panes from jumping before their layout is ready by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33788
* Keep chat button hover colors readable when the theme changes by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33791
* Stop retrying a failing rename for old chat names made only of invisible characters by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33678

### Agent launch, status & accounts

*Navigate Claude subagents, resume agents with the settings they had, and see the right status and history.*

* Open a Claude subagent’s view from the sidebar or dashboard, and track which one Claude is showing by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33322
* Keep agents you set separately when you pick a permission for all agents by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33018
* Resume Claude sessions at their own effort level by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33765
* Keep a background agent launch’s flags when it is resumed by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33776
* Resume a Codex thread with the permission it was last given, not Orca’s launch flag by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33460
* Offer to restart System default Claude sessions signed in to the old account when switching accounts by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33793
* Keep MiMo’s login and sessions while Orca adds its status plugin by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33668
* Deliver Kimi’s first prompt on Windows and after Kimi is ready by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33581
* Let Codex’s stricter Windows sandbox read Orca’s managed Codex folder by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33748
* Show Claude and Codex panes as waiting while the folder-trust dialog is open by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33804
* Recognize a hand-typed Claude at its startup dialogs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33826
* Stop false Antigravity needs-attention from tab titles and auto-approved prompts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33671
* Keep Codex’s hidden title-writing prompt off the sidebar heading by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33746
* Keep a Pi row working while a pi-subagents child is still running by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33738
* Keep Hermes named profiles reporting status to their pane by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33742
* Stop a Codex run inside a Claude background job from labelling the Claude pane as Codex by @stakost in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24641
* Detect Grok CLI installed only in ~/.grok/bin by @brynnclaw in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25324
* List Claude sessions from a wrapper script’s or launch setting’s CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR in Agent Session History by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33751
* List OpenCode sessions from Orca-managed data accounts in Agent Session History by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33658
* Resume OpenCode sessions under the account that owns them by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33753
* List a chat once, under the app that wrote it, when Pi and OMP share a sessions folder by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33647
* Delete a server-hosted session on the server that owns it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33906
* Resume a server session whose workspace was deleted, and show previews for remote search hits by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33965
* Send only an error code, not the raw message, when reporting a failed agent hook install by @brynnclaw in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25287

### Orchestration & CLI

*Workers report to the right coordinator and read all their mail, and CLI commands fail clearly.*

* Find a worker’s coordinator from the caller, so starting a worker on another server works by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33744
* Stop workers from taking over the Run they work for by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29008
* Teach workers to acknowledge and drain mail batches so newer messages aren’t hidden by @1aifanatic in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26768
* Keep a worker’s finished report when a late startup step fails by @1aifanatic in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26762
* Keep paging forward through a worker transcript after a page fills by @kaznowski in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32894
* Show a terminal’s orphaned state in plain `orca terminal list` and `show` output by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33910
* Reject empty --terminal and --from handles instead of falling back to defaults by @Cunninger in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/16745
* Accept an empty --value in browser fill and select commands by @2sumtech in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/16030
* Teach agents about `orca terminal read --screen`, and fix two `orca --help` lines by @webdevtodayjason in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/15893
* Correct the split --direction wording in the CLI guide agents read by @kaynansc in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/9038
* Press the requested named keys and hotkey letters in computer use on Linux by @AlgoraAndrew in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22494
* Let computer use set text fields on Linux systems such as Ubuntu 24.04 by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/10586
* Press the plain shortcut for uppercase hotkey letters in computer use on Windows by @jespo2021 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27642

### Terminals

*Lighter terminal hosts, cleaner repaints, and fixes for Windows, Linux, macOS and Korean input.*

* Start every terminal through one path, so simultaneous starts from the window and the CLI or phone share one result by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32076
* Inspect idle local shell panes less often, cutting terminal host memory and idle CPU by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33829
* Cap the terminal host’s short-lived memory so it stays smaller when idle and after bursts by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33837
* Keep a pane moved into a new tab in its new tab on paired servers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33027
* Answer terminal queries in output sent just as a paired terminal is paused, so fish doesn’t freeze by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33749
* Answer terminal queries in parked output a paused paired terminal discards by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33783
* Open another client’s terminal under its own tab instead of a second copy by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33978
* Stop lines drawing twice and color codes showing as text when you return to a hidden pane by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33880
* Skip a half-sent color or title code when a hidden pane’s restore is abandoned by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33905
* Repaint Codex and Claude Code over the skipped-hidden-output notice by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33835
* Save output once for in-app terminals running behind a degraded terminal host by @Muriano in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33119
* Return a tab from the chat view to the terminal once you’re back at the shell after quitting an agent by @zhangxaochen in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30614
* Stop a closed terminal from being reported as stuck while its history was still loading by @dansolombrino in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31095
* Keep your scrolled-up reading position in place as old scrollback is trimmed by @Meapri in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23334
* Keep typed keys held for a starting agent from blocking stuck-pane recovery by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33865
* Keep find-bar highlights when moving between matches with Cmd+G and Cmd+Shift+G by @AntonioKL in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18844
* Send a word jump once, not twice, while Korean input is composing by @ethznn in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/17624
* Let focus-follows-mouse move between the floating and main workspace terminals by @oha-4 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29914
* Stop new terminals inheriting Claude Code’s nested-session variables when Orca was started from Claude Code by @Baek-Seunghyun in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/10188
* Send real Alt+Left/Right in local Windows terminals so Codex can switch agents by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33463
* Notice when an agent launched in Windows PowerShell exits by @hwantage in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18182
* Run Windows launchers from folders with spaces or parentheses by @thsvkd in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/13501
* Keep terminals working on Linux with glibc 2.42 and newer by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33803
* Warn in the log when Linux terminals inherit a limit that kills long-running jobs by @JacobHonore in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29762
* Stop several macOS terminals opened at once from waiting 3 seconds for a shell by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33833
* Track terminals and agent sessions on Macs set to other languages and regions by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33898
* Read macOS processes with no terminal correctly by @aashish254 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23251

### SSH, WSL & remote servers

*Paired servers keep your tabs, WSL hosts stay paired and lighter, and SSH errors say what went wrong.*

* Keep a paired server’s workspace tabs across desktop restarts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33926
* Stop closed tabs coming back after a restart on a host moved to its managed server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33702
* Keep a closed browser tab on a paired server closed after Orca quits without a clean shutdown by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33972
* Remove terminal tabs a paired server closed, and offer Close Pane on a closed remote terminal by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33949
* Remember which tab you switched to with the keyboard on a paired server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33761
* Stop desktops that serve each other from passing back each other’s editor tabs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33752
* Forget each restored workspace’s last machine once that machine answers, even if another is unreachable by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33863
* List a host’s terminal agents again when it comes back by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33816
* Show a server added with `orca environment add` in every window right away by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33930
* Recover saved servers when a crash left the saved-server file empty by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33864
* Add a per-host Reconnect on launch toggle for SSH hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33935
* Open SSH workspaces in more editors, directly on the remote host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33877
* Show what SSH said when Connect never reaches the host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33928
* Say why an SSH host failed in the Add project host picker by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33992
* Name a Windows SSH host that’s too old or can’t unpack Orca’s runtime by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33682
* Use SSH keys whose IdentityFile path has tokens like %d or ${NAME} by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33981
* Move through the remote folder browser with the arrow keys by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33914
* Refuse a second Orca server on a host cloned with the same machine id, and say how to fix it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33775
* Keep remote file drops out of git, and say why a drop or file open failed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33831
* Explain that a headless host can’t share artifacts or skills yet by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33754
* Keep macOS `orca serve` out of the Dock, and let Linux servers opt in to the GPU by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33878
* Stop a server’s idle session-history helper after a minute to save memory by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33845
* Give the session-history helper 3 idle minutes on WSL hosts and 10 on SSH hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33897
* Connect to WSL host servers through bash instead of Node, using far less memory by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33820
* Keep a WSL host’s bridge port across app restarts so it isn’t re-paired by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33109

body:
## Chats and a browser that behave the way you expect 🧭

This release makes chats follow your agent settings, brings Chrome-style tools to the built-in browser, and helps SSH connections and managed servers recover. You’ll also find a chat font setting, live agent browsing, and steadier Hermes, Kimi, Kiro and Windows terminals.

## The short version

- **Chats that follow your settings:** New chats use each agent’s permission from Settings → Agents, renamed chats keep their names in Session History, and a chat won’t write a conversation a terminal is still running.
- **A browser closer to Chrome:** Dock DevTools inside the pane, mute tabs playing sound, see a link’s URL on hover, and use Orca shortcuts and mouse back/forward inside pages.
- **Watch agents browse:** A cursor and badge show where an agent is clicking or typing, chat jumps you to the page, and links from terminals and chat open beside their source.
- **SSH with fewer dead ends:** Saved port forwards return after a restart and explain failures, certificate-only hosts connect through your system `ssh`, and managed servers update without closing terminals.
- **Agents that start and resume reliably:** Hermes and Kimi panes resume after a restart, Kiro reports status on its V3 engine, and keys typed while an agent starts are kept as a draft.
- **Polish where it counts:** Pick a font for chat, zoom with Cmd/Ctrl + `+` on non-US keyboards, open cloud-only files from macOS terminals, and get steadier Windows terminals and pasting.

**Phone & web updates:** Phones no longer drop pieces of terminal output, and chat renames and each chat’s permission mode now show there. Session tabs also keep Working and Needs You for Windows agents that never set a title.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Fresh terminal host:** New terminals start on a fresh terminal host so this release’s terminal fixes apply. Terminals already open before you update keep running, and stay attached, on the previous host until you close them.
- **Chat permissions:** Settings → Chat no longer has its own permission dropdown; set it per agent in Settings → Agents. Existing chats keep their saved permission, and a chat’s own permission menu changes only that chat.
- **Conversations open in a terminal:** If a terminal might still be writing a conversation, its chat won’t send and asks you to quit the agent there or close that terminal. Closing that terminal lets the next send go through.
- **Managed SSH servers:** **Update anyway** keeps running terminals going through the update. The offer to resume chats after a restart needs a server already running this release.
- **OpenCode model picks:** OpenCode 2.0.14, 2.0.15, 2.0.17 and 2.0.18 leave the first message unsent when a model is picked, so Orca refuses model picks on those versions.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Chats share your agent settings, keep their names, and stay out of conversations a terminal is still writing.*

* Start new chats with each agent’s permission setting from Settings → Agents, the same as terminals by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32334
* Never start a chat’s agent on a conversation a terminal is still writing, and keep restored panes from resuming a conversation an open chat holds by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30930
* Save chat renames as the chat’s name, so Session History, phones and other windows keep showing them after the tab closes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31602
* Show turns made outside an OpenCode or Grok chat when the chat continues by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31616
* Offer to resume interrupted chats after a paired or managed server restarts or updates by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28978
* Add a custom font family setting for chat, with a preview and installed-font suggestions by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33687
* Retry a failed agent start before rejecting your message by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33045
* Keep goal text whose delivery is uncertain, and send each distinct goal control to the host by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33022
* Keep an idle Claude chat idle when a background task reports progress by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22879
* Fold Claude thinking-only transcript records into the reasoning section by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33344
* Honour Claude Code’s rejected ANTHROPIC_API_KEY setting in chats by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33346
* Keep long Pi replies with lots of thinking from stopping early by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33293
* Reconnect an OMP chat when OMP drops its session by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33359
* Keep a remembered effort for OMP models other than the running one in new chats by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33646
* Stop refusing new Pi chats when a remembered effort is missing from the saved model list by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33637
* Read WSL Claude transcripts through linked folders, so chats from Orca-managed Claude accounts load on mobile by @Kooooojun in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33172
* Keep a resting Codex chat’s skills check from blocking worktree removal on Windows by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33569

### Browser

*Chrome-style DevTools, tab audio and link previews, plus a live view of agents using the browser.*

* Dock DevTools inside the browser pane, with dock side, resizing and pop-out by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33003
* Show a speaker icon on browser tabs playing sound, with tab mute by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32981
* Show a hovered or focused link’s URL in a bubble at the bottom of the page by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32978
* Make Orca shortcuts, split focus and mouse back/forward buttons work inside web pages by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31859
* Open browser links beside their source by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32907
* Show agent browsing live, with a jump to the page from chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33075
* Ask before sites use the local network by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33399
* Show bigger new tab tiles and a roomier workspace card by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33178

### Agent launch, status & accounts

*Agents start on the first try, report the right status, resume in the right place, and keep the right account.*

* Press Enter again while DeepSeek Harness’s launchpad still holds the prompt by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33316

* Start a Claude worker on its composer when its terminal title is turned off by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33384
* Pre-trust the folder for Kimi Code so its trust menu does not swallow the prompt by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33411
* Refuse model picks on OpenCode 2.x releases that drop the startup prompt by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33436
* Recognize Qwen Code launched through Node on Windows by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33461
* Keep Codex from reading as idle while its plan menu is showing after its Stop hook by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33335
* Let a settled screen clear a blocked-prompt state left over after the agent erased its dialog by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33485
* Show Needs You while a Claude MCP elicitation dialog is open by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33517
* Let a pane’s own agent reclaim its status from a nested agent’s hooks by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33572
* Keep agent status on a terminal moved into a new tab after a restart by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33601
* Stop an Antigravity subagent finishing from ending its parent’s turn by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33645
* Keep Pi in-process subagent sessions from taking over the lead pane by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33595
* Follow Claude sessions continued into a daemon job by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33605

* Resume an agent from the folder it ran in, not the pane’s starting folder by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33527
* Resume Hermes panes after a restart, on the pane’s own session by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33514
* Keep a finished Hermes pane done when its background memory review calls tools by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33418
* Use the Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes home for Hermes hooks and session history by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33413
* Recognize Hermes readiness and its installed launcher by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33606
* Keep a resumed Kimi pane resumable across the next Orca restart by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33489
* Report Kiro status on Kiro’s V3 engine, including the built-in default agent by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33660
* Run the native Windows Claude hook for profile paths with spaces by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33364

* Capture Git Bash agent environments with native Windows paths by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33619
* Write folder trust into the managed Codex account home the launch uses by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33377
* Apply global ~/.codex/rules in Orca-managed Codex homes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33493
* Migrate resumed Windows Codex sessions whose transcript path has a \\?\ prefix by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33558

name: Orca Mobile Android mobile-android-v0.0.59
body:
Thank you for using Orca mobile! ❤️

## What's new

- Opening Orca after your computer updates is about twice as fast. Downloads are decoded faster, and only the files that changed are fetched instead of the whole app.
- The download progress bar now fills smoothly instead of jumping to the end.
- Going back to a screen you already have open takes you there instead of opening another copy.
- Terminal output that the phone sometimes dropped, such as the screen reset after a full-screen program exits, now shows up.

Most phone features come from your desktop, so update Orca on your computer to get everything. See the [desktop release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) for the full list.

### Verify your download

- Size: `136281689` bytes
- SHA-256: `f8a18086b04dc00966431edc4d484132d6fc8dc08a5d88009a3246317a12f343`

A "no certificate" or "problem parsing the package" install failure is usually a truncated download — check the size first, then `sha256sum -c app-release.apk.sha256` (`shasum -a 256 -c` on macOS).

name: v1.4.240
body:
## A more dependable workspace 🐳

This release gives the built-in browser searchable history, makes agent activity easier to follow, and improves recovery across chats and remote terminals. You’ll also find Lean and Zig syntax highlighting, support for larger quick-command collections, and a new `orca ports` command for finding your dev servers.

## The short version

- **Conversations that stay with you:** Claude chats now show turns made outside Orca. Retained messages return after reconnect without reopening the chat, and crash recovery no longer guesses that a sent message was undelivered.
- **A browser with a better memory:** Search your browsing history, reopen pages, remove unwanted suggestions, and clear history with Undo. Pages can also use files you pick, save or drop through File System Access.
- **Remote work with fewer interruptions:** Slow connections survive missed wake probes, reconnect notices explain what is happening, SSH terminals wait for sign-in, and new splits stay on the paired server.
- **Agent status you can trust:** Completed Codex subagents stop showing as Working, running main tasks stay visible through `/side` conversations, and Codex MCP tools that require approval get an approval card.
- **More room for your workflow:** Save more than 40 quick commands, find a worktree’s detected dev-server ports with `orca ports`, and reclaim old dependency installs and build output from development worktrees.
- **Polish where it counts:** Lean and Zig highlighting, clearer session-search excerpts, smoother Mac trackpad scrolling in terminal apps, and better protection for unmerged branches and worktrees shared between Windows and WSL.

**Phone & web updates:** Updating Orca on the computer serving your phone or browser updates the served interface. This release also keeps running Codex tasks visible on paired and mobile views during `/side` conversations and fixes browser-picked or dropped chat attachments uploading to the paired server.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Native chat (experimental):** Update paired and SSH hosts alongside Orca for the latest chat, agent-status and launch fixes. Codex’s new approval cards cover MCP tool approvals that do not require form fields; general MCP forms and URL-based verification are not supported by this change.
- **Browser history:** Open **History** from the page menu, or use **Cmd+Y** on macOS and **Ctrl+H** on Linux and Windows. Search, remove individual entries, or clear the last hour, today or all time, with Undo for clearing.
- **Detected ports:** `orca ports` supports workspace selection and JSON output on runtimes with host-scoped port scanning. Direct SSH hosts do not support detection yet; native folder workspaces require `--all` to list the host’s listeners.
- **Development cleanup:** Manual `pnpm reclaim-space` and automatic cleanup on development launches can reclaim ignored, untracked dependency installs and generated output in old sibling worktrees, using a default 30-day cutoff. Selected, invoking and excluded worktrees remain protected. Stop sibling apps, agents, installs, builds and tests before applying manual cleanup; reclaimed installs and output need reinstalling or rebuilding when used again.
- **Terminal file links:** The earlier change to open a file link in the workspace where it was clicked was reverted in this release.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Catch up on conversations, reconnect without extra steps, and answer agent prompts with clearer controls.*

* Show turns made outside Orca in an existing Claude chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31615
* Show retained chat messages after reconnect without reopening the chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32255
* Keep sent messages from being falsely marked undelivered after a crash, and stop scanning the transcript on every reopen by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30580
* Show approval cards for Codex MCP tools that require permission by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33310
* Submit Claude question-preview answers with Enter by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33332
* Match terminal pane split and close menus in chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28969
* Display unknown HTML tags as text instead of dropping them by @anmol0b in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30819
* Alert the orchestration coordinator when a chat worker errors by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31941
* Deliver follow-ups to running Codex goals using the choices the goal inherits by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33300
* Upload chat attachments picked or dropped in a web client to the paired server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33060

### Agent activity & integrations

*See the task that is actually running, keep completed work settled, and launch agents with the right session and settings.*

* Record Stop immediately and settle subagents when their exit is confirmed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28051

name: v1.4.239
body:
**Two releases today!** Check out the [v1.4.238 release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.238) too. That release brought shared unsaved edits across workspaces, richer agent chats and remote account setup, a more capable browser, and smoother phone controls.

## Your workspace, working together 🐳

Set up agent skills in one click, keep browser sessions separate between projects, and move more easily between chat and terminal. This release also strengthens the essentials: shared files stay in sync, SSH sessions recover more reliably, and phone interactions feel more predictable.

## The short version

- **Skills, ready wherever you work:** Install Orca’s skills in one click from setup screens, and install or update them on paired servers and SSH hosts with Orca’s own installer.
- **A browser that fits your projects:** Choose shared, per-repo or per-workspace profiles for new tabs. Keep local app logins separate, use a familiar page context menu, and get clearer explanations when a page cannot load.
- **More fluid agent conversations:** Split into a fresh chat beside your current one, continue with a terminal agent from the pane header, and keep queued messages and multiple image attachments intact.
- **Safer edits, quieter background work:** Shared file views stay current after undo and discard. Non-UTF-8 files ask before conversion, file watching recovers after slowdowns, and Orca watches fewer unrelated files.
- **Remote work with a way back:** Recover supported managed SSH servers from a stale lock in Settings, restore terminals after password sign-in, and keep a paired server’s SSH access link through restarts.
- **Better from your phone:** Tapping a notification opens the agent that sent it, agent chat tabs can start dictation, terminal copy commands reach the phone clipboard, and Android scrolling keeps the keyboard out of the way.
- **Everyday polish, across languages:** Better Korean input, Bengali and other Indic terminal rendering, more complete translations, Jira user pickers, and PR comment links that jump straight to the editor.

**Phone updates:** Updating Orca on the computer serving your phone updates the served interface. Native download, progress and navigation improvements require an updated native phone app.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Browser profiles:** Choose **Settings → Browser → Profile for new tabs**. **Shared** remains the default; per-repo and per-workspace profiles apply to new tabs. Paired-server pages use the server’s own profiles.
- **Native chat (experimental):** Update paired and SSH hosts alongside Orca for the latest chat and launch fixes. Chat availability now checks the chat runtime separately from the terminal CLI, including supported Antigravity setups.
- **SSH recovery:** **Recover server…** is available for supported managed Linux SSH hosts reporting a stale-lock refusal. It checks the lock and asks you to confirm that no other machine sharing that home is running Orca before clearing it. Phones point you to desktop Settings.
- **Experimental groundwork:** Connector work remains behind the off-by-default `experimentalConnectors` flag. The layout-owner groundwork remains disabled. The empty-group launch actions and child-workspace status toggle were reverted before release.
