name: v1.4.238
body:
## More connected work, safer edits 🐳

This release makes it easier to move between agents, files, browsers and remote machines. Tabs of the same file now share unsaved edits, native chats pick up turns made elsewhere, and the phone gets more dependable terminal gestures and richer tab controls.

## The short version

- **Your edits stay together:** Tabs of the same file share unsaved text across workspaces. Conflict review sees that live text, workspace deletion lists unsaved files, and stale Markdown or notebook edits no longer overwrite newer work.
- **Chats that keep up:** Codex and Pi show turns made outside the chat. Long pastes can become text attachments, Codex questions get answer cards, and OMP gains image sending and actionable plan-review cards.
- **More control over agents:** Pick chat or terminal when creating a workspace, set that choice for your default agent, add Claude and Codex accounts on supported remote servers, and install shared skills for 11 more agents.
- **A more capable browser:** A workspace-aware new tab, address-bar suggestions, remembered site permissions, per-site appearance and zoom, and page-loading progress on desktop and phone.
- **A smoother phone experience:** See agent activity in tabs, rename with a double-tap, scroll back through earlier chat messages, select terminal text more naturally, and return to your terminal reading position after resuming.
- **Better visibility and recovery:** Inspect local terminals in Resource Manager, use plain SSH when a host’s move to an Orca server is blocked, and keep pairings through managed-server updates and recovery.
- **Everyday polish:** Brazilian Portuguese, language selection during onboarding, searchable release builds, clearer history-scan progress, and **Resolve with AI** for paused merges, rebases and cherry-picks—even after file conflicts are fixed.

**Phone updates:** Updating Orca on the computer serving your phone updates the served interface. The new **Home → New Workspace** entry and native iOS dictation fixes require an updated native phone app; the home-screen entry ships with the next app build.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Remote accounts:** Update the paired server for the new Claude and Codex Add Account flow. Windows servers and older hosts retain the `orca account add` guidance. Credentials stay on the server; remote re-authentication of an existing account is outside this change.
- **Native chat (experimental):** Update paired and SSH hosts alongside Orca for the latest chat fixes. Agent version checks now accept newer releases and prereleases that meet the required minimum; a known older version shows update guidance.
- **Resource Manager:** The new PTYs view covers local terminals. Ending a terminal requires host support for verifying the selected session; older hosts refuse unchecked termination.
- **HTML files:** Opening HTML in preview by default was reverted for this release.
- **Experimental groundwork:** Layout-owner and sidebar changes listed below remain disabled. Connector configuration is off by default, and the new optional agent-write controls have no existing callers enabled.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Continue conversations across chat and terminal, answer agent questions, and share images and long prompts more easily.*

* Show turns made outside Orca in an existing Codex chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30883
* Show turns made outside Orca in an existing Pi chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31618
* Attach long pastes as text files and flag oversized messages before sending by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30398
* Codex async questions show an answer card on desktop and phone by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31652
* OMP's plan review shows as a plan card you can answer from desktop and mobile chat by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31635
* Questions over 16 KB show their card with every option by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31632
* OMP chats send images; an ACP agent's own startup answer decides by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30910
* Keep newer agent versions and eligible prereleases available for chat, with clear guidance when an installed version is too old by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30393
* Keep model choices coherent across Claude updates by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30107
* Typing fast after focus moves keeps keys in order by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31203
* Retire ghost queued continuation bubbles by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31479
* Show a prompt hook's block as its own row for every agent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30898
* A cancelled approval card closes even when the journal was briefly full by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31735
* Open inline images directly in preview dialog by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31620
* Handle inline image preview edge cases by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31742
* Set minimum width for native chat table cells by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31848
* Gate draft image ownership checks by local attachments by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32098
* Avoid repeated skill catalog scans while building the picker by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31936

### Agents, accounts & skills

*Choose chat or terminal when starting work, add accounts on a remote server, and install shared skills for more agents.*

* Choose chat or terminal CLI in Create worktree, Create folder and continuation pickers by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31189
* Set the default agent to open as a chat or a terminal CLI by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31590
* Add Claude and Codex accounts on supported remote servers from a paired desktop by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31461
* Restart WSL Claude panes after an account switch by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31945
* Install shared skills for 11 more agents and stop Qoder listing skills twice by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31657
* Preserve Cursor identity across imported Claude hooks by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31469
* Renaming a terminal no longer hides its running agent by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31428
* Route OMP question cards to terminal by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31440

### Phone: tabs, chat & workspaces

*Read earlier messages without losing your place, see agent activity in the tab strip, and keep workspace actions on the right computer.*

* Tab strip shows terminal and chat agent state, reveals the next tab, renames on double-tap by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31372
* Load earlier chat messages on scroll-up, keeping the reader's place by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31339
* Phone terminal and chat tab names match the desktop by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31384
* Closing the tab a phone shows returns it to the tab it viewed before by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31365
* Keep closed terminal tabs from reappearing after quick closes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31711
* New Tab drawer reopens with its agents and refreshes them when desktop does by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31367
* Keep a Codex chat on screen when Codex shows its idle title on a headless host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31460
* Floating-panel chats started from a phone show on the desktop by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31364
* Mobile chat composer uses desktop's placeholder by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31425
* Attach Codex images when agent identity is missing by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31370
* Refresh chat file suggestions when the desktop connection changes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31702
* Load the right agent history when you switch computers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31695
* Prepare Home’s New Workspace drawer; the home-screen entry requires the next native phone app build by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31305
* Open Create Workspace after source drawer closes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31488
* Detect New Workspace agents in the selected repo runtime by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31351
* Load folder workspace agent presets on the correct host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31442
* Keep your setup-script choice when the repository list refreshes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31694
* Warn about agents that cannot wake on a windowless server only when the workspace has sleeping agents by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31607
* Recover workspace features after temporary connection checks fail by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31480
* Keep selected mobile options visible while locked by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31628
* Announce locked picker notice on iOS by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31674

### Phone: terminals, voice & touch

*Select text more naturally, return to the same reading position, and keep scrolling, dictation and keyboard input dependable.*

* Drag terminal selection with the long-press finger by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31433
* Select Unicode words at rendered cell boundaries by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31434
* Keep terminal scroll gestures from becoming taps by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31445
* Preserve prompt taps after terminal scrolling by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31471
* Start phone terminal scrolling without a timer delay by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31472
* Retain terminal reading position after resume by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31661
* Prevent stale terminal sizing and stream callbacks from affecting a newer phone session by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31432
* Clear old touch gestures before replaying a terminal snapshot by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31437
* Cancel stale shortcut list drags by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31436
* Preserve native iOS dictation placeholders by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31356
* Restore dictation after iOS audio interruptions by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31435
* Mount sessions with saved preferences by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31443
* Terminal settings show the saved "When you leave the mobile app" choice by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31361
* Render offline Nerd Font symbols on first terminal display by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31446
* Apply desktop terminal WebGL rendering fixes on phone by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31441
* Fill the background below the final terminal row by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31474
* Keep terminal wait feedback visible with a draft by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31658
* Terminal Paste says why when nothing is pasted by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31640
* Handle Android terminal keyboard chords in OTA sessions by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31666
* Remember your latest choice for opening terminal links by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31689
* Keep newer quick-command edits when an earlier save finishes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31704

### Phone: files, reviews & connections

*Keep drafts with their files, preserve recent edits, and recover more clearly from connection and loading failures.*

* Keep review-note drafts with the file they belong to by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31698
* Keep generated commit messages in the workspace that requested them by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31709
* Show Retry when a commit's changed files fail to load by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31706
* Refresh open subfolders and keep deeply nested filenames visible by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31697
* Keep a closed branch preview from reopening when loading finishes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31707
* Keep the notification switch from flipping back after you enable it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31690
* Stop a slow connection save from sending you back twice by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31692
* Use port 443 for explicit WSS host edits by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31659
* Distinguish delayed connection deadlines from unreachable hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31478
* Speed up phone diff-review note lookup by file path by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31943

### Browser

*Open a workspace-aware new tab, find sites from the address bar, and control permissions, appearance and zoom per site.*

* New tab page with a workspace card and suggested sites by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31656
* Chrome-style new tab and address bar suggestions by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31604

* Show every page load, link clicks included, as a line along the address bar on desktop and mobile by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31597

### Editor, files & source control

*Share unsaved text across tabs of the same file, protect edits during saves and workspace removal, and get help with paused Git operations.*

* Keep tabs of the same file in sync with one shared record of unsaved edits by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31974

name: v1.4.237
body:
## 100,000 stars. Thank you! ⭐🐳

Orca just crossed **100,000 stars on GitHub**! Every bug report, pull request, shared workflow and recommendation has helped us get here. Thank you for building with Orca and helping shape what comes next. ❤️

To celebrate, this release brings a more capable phone experience, more dependable agent conversations, and fixes that keep your work moving across desktops and remote machines.

## The short version

- **More done from your phone:** Create and edit notes, save Markdown on headless hosts, follow relative file links, and see embedded images. Buffered terminal drafts can now survive workspace navigation, too.
- **Chats you can come back to:** Codex chats reopen correctly after undo, Claude keeps its rewound context across Orca rollbacks, and screenshots stay with the conversation. Codex’s skill picker now reflects the skills Codex actually loaded.
- **Your work stays protected:** Discard pauses autosave of the same file across workspaces. Read-only Markdown and CSV views protect your unsaved edits, and new, unstaged Markdown documents open straight into the rich editor.
- **Voice beyond the desktop:** Phone dictation works again through headless `orca serve` hosts, with a CLI command to configure the host’s OpenAI key.
- **Smoother remote work:** Reconnect hidden terminal tabs after a restart, keep browser logins when hosts pair again, and search SSH configurations with thousands of hosts without freezing the interface.
- **Small details, better flow:** Phone tabs follow desktop order, landscape layouts show the session title, keyboard controls keep their height, and worktree safety sweeps skip unchanged workspaces.

**Phone updates:** Updating Orca on the computer serving your phone also updates the phone’s served interface. Persistent terminal drafts additionally require an updated mobile shell.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Native chat (experimental):** Update paired and SSH hosts alongside Orca to get the latest chat fixes. Exact Codex skill-file selection is available on desktop with a supporting host; phone selections and older hosts retain plain-text skill names. Send a skill as a new message for Codex to apply it at the start of a turn.
- **Headless dictation:** Save the OpenAI key on the host doing the transcription with `orca speech openai-key set` (reads the key from stdin). Installed-app `orca serve` hosts on Linux and macOS can also use the bundled on-device recognizer; Windows, managed SSH and WSL servers use cloud models.
- **CLI launch choice:** Explicit `--surface` choices require an updated execution host. Omitting the option keeps your existing defaults.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Pick the skills Codex actually loaded, return to conversations with confidence, and keep your chat history and attachments intact.*

* Use Codex’s own loaded-skill catalog in chat; desktop selections identify the exact skill file, including when names overlap by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30937
* Reopen Codex chats after undo and continue with the correct conversation history by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31041
* Keep Claude’s rewound context intact even after rolling back Orca by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31231
* Show prompts sent mid-turn and `!` commands where Claude actually received them by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31204
* Keep screenshots dragged into a chat available for the lifetime of that chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30419
* Retry failed chat names, show naming errors on the tab hover card, and offer **Regenerate name** by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30646
* Keep resumed Claude chats ready to receive messages after settings updates by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30982
* Show **Working** only while Claude, Pi or ACP is handling work, while keeping Claude chat workers running by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30577
* Show sleeping native-chat workspaces as asleep and hide them when the sidebar filter calls for it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28457
* Tie finished notifications to the correct hook-driven turn by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30620
* Clarify how to continue conversations between chat and terminal agents by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31402

### Phone

*Move between workspaces without losing your draft, work on Markdown without an open desktop window, and enjoy a more consistent interface.*

* Open a worktree on the tab currently shown on desktop by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31215
* List session tabs in the same order as the desktop tab bar by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31269
* Keep unsent buffered terminal commands when leaving and reopening a workspace by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31314
* Create and edit notes on headless hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31291
* Read and save Markdown tabs without an open desktop window, with conflict checks that protect unsaved desktop edits by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31101
* Keep a Markdown save on its original host if the workspace moves while saving by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31376
* Open relative file links from Markdown by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31298
* Display embedded images in Markdown previews by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31304
* Refresh staged files when returning from review by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31295
* Show the session title beside tabs when the phone is in landscape by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30879
* Blend the status-bar area into the workspace header by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31353
* Match the home-indicator area to the terminal input panel by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31354
* Preserve live terminal palettes when the selected theme has not changed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31355
* Keep Claude chats intact after renaming their pane by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31358
* Show the bundled whale icon on DeepSeek Build tabs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31359
* Keep the keyboard accessory row at a stable height when the dismiss button appears by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31363
* Keep dictation controls in sync with the host’s settings by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31349
* Simplify chat by removing the Tools toggle and its open-everything mode by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31188

### Voice & agent launches

*Dictate from your phone through a headless server, and choose chat or terminal for an individual CLI launch.*

* Restore voice dictation on headless `orca serve` hosts, with cloud models on managed SSH, WSL and Windows servers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31217
* Configure a headless host’s OpenAI dictation key with `orca speech openai-key status`, `set` and `clear` by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31230
* Choose `--surface chat` or `--surface terminal` for `orca agent launch` and agent-backed `orca worktree create` by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31191

### Editor, files & performance

*Protect unsaved work across tabs and workspaces, make new Markdown documents immediately editable, and reduce background activity.*

* Open new, unstaged Markdown files from Source Control in the rich editor by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31399
* Pause autosave across workspaces during Source Control Discard, and prevent read-only Markdown or CSV tabs from overwriting unsaved edits by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31413
* Avoid an unnecessary reload of remote files after each restart by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31196
* Prevent restored-tab disk checks from looping or reporting false conflicts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31250
* Skip unchanged worktrees during background safety sweeps by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31253
* Apply custom tab shortcuts immediately after switching worktrees with the keyboard by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30941

### Terminals, SSH & remote servers

*Reconnect to surviving sessions, handle large SSH configurations, and keep remote updates and browser logins dependable.*

* Start agent terminals at their first real size without the previous 12-frame wait by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30442
* Attach to the successful connection when terminal reconnect attempts overlap by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30448
* Reconnect hidden terminal tabs to sessions that survived a restart by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31254
* Prevent a saved terminal folder on an unavailable network drive from freezing the window by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31381
* Keep mobile terminal snapshots aligned after removing terminal queries by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31348
* Keep the SSH Hosts list responsive and searchable with configurations containing 13,000 hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31405
* Use the same bounded, searchable picker across host lists so large SSH configurations remain usable throughout Orca by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31426
* Preserve in-app browser logins when a WSL or managed SSH host pairs again by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29610
* Replace stale terminal daemons after they drain on Linux and WSL by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31235
* Restart the macOS serve supervisor from the updated app by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31200
* Prepare the macOS supervisor’s code copy in one step by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31303
* Prevent sidebar view settings from blocking SSH host migration by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31374
* Refuse new terminal creation while a server update is stopping the server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29834
* Give Windows process-tree cleanup time to finish rather than leaving grandchildren behind by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29501
* Put sharing first in **Remote Orca Servers** settings by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31335

### History, projects & source control

*Find conversations across machines more easily, and keep project actions tied to the host that owns them.*

* Keep scoped Session History working with very large transcript collections by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30905
* Give history searches through SSH-connected Orca servers the full all-hosts scan budget by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31226
* Include sessions saved under a symlinked workspace’s real path in Workspace history by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31244
* Label the source host when history search results span multiple machines by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31261
* Open PR cards, rows and dialogs on the host that returned the item when projects share a path by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31252
* Keep GitLab items and project dialogs on their owning host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31271
* Save issue-source changes to the selected project row by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31319
* Use the caller’s host for GitHub routing and task filters by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31263
* Separate work-item cache entries by project row and host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31290
* Find registered projects by ID, path and host during refreshes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31274
* Clear repository cache entries without evicting another live host’s project by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31312
* Refuse ambiguous legacy automations instead of guessing which host should run them by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31234
* Reject workspace parents that would create a nesting loop, including before the worktree cache is loaded by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29340
* Fetch PR conflict-preview base branches through the shared fetch controller by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30654

### Tests, builds & maintenance

*Faster release builds, broader platform coverage, dependency checks and continued editor cleanup. The layout-owner work below remains behind disabled build switches and is not enabled in this release.*

* ci(wsl): run the WSL orcad lane on Debian 12 and Fedora 41 too by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29821
* Refactor AGENTS.md for clarity and conciseness by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31238

* Update AGENTS.md with Useful Commands section by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31248
* Editor tab state is written to its buffer record, not copied into it afterwards (phase 1a) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31251
* docs: clarify first-class platform, remote, and mobile priorities by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31265
* test(daemon): run the stalled-reader backpressure test over a Unix socket, not TCP loopback by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31256
* refactor(protocol): each area owns its published runtime capability list by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30641

* refactor(wsl-hosts): add flow in wsl-host-registration; liveness split into state, evidence and monitor by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29506

name: v1.4.235
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

This release makes conversations easier to revisit, keeps more of your agent's work, and cuts background editor activity when you're juggling workspaces.

## The short version

- **Rewind Claude chats:** Use **Rewind to here** on a message that started a turn, edit your prompt, and take the conversation in a new direction. Claude continues from the history you kept.
- **Your chat, your settings:** Each conversation remembers its own model, effort and Fast settings. Switching models keeps compatible choices, and changes to an agent's defaults no longer silently move a chat that has recorded its settings.
- **Keep more of your agent's work:** Completed replies and tool results are saved in full rather than cut off at the preview limit. Use **Show full output** on desktop or phone, or **Show full message** on phone, to load more content from shortened previews.
- **Less waiting, less background work:** New Chat opens the composer immediately, Codex chats get the time they need to start, and the workspace jump palette is preloaded. The editor watches active, recent and at-risk workspaces instead of every workspace with an open tab.
- **A better phone experience:** Live chats reconnect from where they left off, project groups stay in step with desktop, and ready cloud dictation models can be selected from the phone. Workspace creation starts preparing the checkout while you fill in the form.
- **Everyday polish:** Edit images in queued desktop messages, see machine labels only when project names collide, and get more reliable workspace lists, file-conflict handling and remote workflows.

**Phone updates:** Updating Orca on your desktop also updates the app on your connected phone—the phone loads it directly from your desktop.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

**Native chat (experimental):** Keep paired and SSH hosts updated alongside Orca for the latest chat features. Full-content loading requires host support; content discarded by older versions cannot be recovered. Very large items may still be shortened for display or delivery.

**Cloud dictation:** Select a ready cloud model from the phone's dictation setup or **Settings → Voice**. Configure its API key on the computer serving the phone first.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Revisit Claude conversations, keep each chat’s settings consistent, and work with images and long outputs more comfortably.*

* Rewind Claude chats from messages that started a turn, continuing with the conversation you kept by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30400
* Remember model, effort, speed and Fast choices per conversation, including across restarts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30561
* Save completed replies and tool results in full, with controls to load more from shortened previews by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29982
* Edit images in queued desktop messages: remove, paste, drop or attach by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30815
* Open the New Chat composer immediately while the host gets ready by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29358
* Wait for Codex when opening or resuming a chat instead of failing after 30 seconds by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30395
* Name chats from the first message immediately, even if automatic title generation fails by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30392
* Avoid starting user MCP servers and hooks for background Claude runs by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30939
* Clarify labels for switching agents between terminal and chat by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31134
* Polish the appearance of chat question options by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31219

### Phone

*Keep conversations and project groups current, create workspaces with less waiting, and select cloud dictation models directly from your phone.*

* Reconnect a chat’s live feed from its last received row when the stream ends by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29007
* Update projects, project groups and workspace rows together so phone grouping stays in sync by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31102
* Prepare the worktree checkout while the new-workspace form is open by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31167
* Select ready cloud dictation models from setup and Settings → Voice by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31221
* Show mobile home statistics when connected to an `orca serve` host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31197
* Keep chat composer controls inside their row by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28983
* Keep session tab icons full size beside long titles by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31169

### Editor, performance & file safety

*Reduce background file watching, speed up workspace navigation, and make reloads and save conflicts more dependable across tabs and devices.*

* Watch active, recent and at-risk workspaces; refresh open files when you return to an unwatched workspace by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30415
* Preload the workspace jump palette before first use by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30935
* Improve save-conflict checks, Undo after reload, autosave during heavy file activity and chat-start error messages by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31216
* Release superseded and closed editor-tab watch probes and disk-check records by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31128
* Avoid reapplying terminal bindings that already match when saving state by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31033

### Workspaces, SSH & remote servers

*Keep workspace lists current, make same-named projects easier to distinguish, and improve remote server transitions and permissions.*

* Show machine labels only when projects have the same name by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31233
* Keep the desktop workspace list current while hidden and include workspaces created on paired servers or other clients by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31090
* Refuse ambiguous same-path project routing instead of following the Active Server selection by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31119
* Allow an older SSH host to move to its managed server while a relay shell identified by its tab remains running by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31093
* Make `orca open-url` on a manually started server ask for a paired desktop rather than an SSH setting by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31120
* Respect the login umask for remote worktrees instead of making them owner-only by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31135
* Improve WSL migration checks for path casing, panes without restore folders and stale agent records by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31211

### Settings & security

*Keep Experimental settings accessible after language updates and tighten permissions for newly created Codex configuration files.*

* Prevent Experimental settings from crashing after language-pack updates by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31202
* Create new Codex `config.toml` files with owner-only permissions by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31228

### Relay service

*Give each relay director revision its own instance limit during rollouts.*

* Use a separate instance maximum per director revision rather than splitting a shared service cap by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31178

### Tests, CI & maintenance

*Expanded compatibility and regression coverage, leaner release builds, and continued terminal-layout groundwork. Layout-owner changes below remain behind a feature switch and are not enabled product features in this release.*

* Layout groundwork (disabled): open CLI- and phone-requested files in the visible tab group by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31123
* Layout groundwork (disabled): surface running terminals without visible panes and determine startup reconnections by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31118

name: v1.4.233
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

We shipped two releases today! If you missed it, check out the [v1.4.232 release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.232) too. Highlights include Manual / Auto / Yolo agent permissions, OpenCode 2 in native chat, a better phone composer with file attachments and inline skills, smoother SSH recovery, and a smaller app with faster Mac updates.

**Phone updates:** Updating Orca on your desktop also updates the app on your connected phone—the phone loads it directly from your desktop.

## The short version

- **SSH & remote workspaces:** Connecting to an SSH host works when neither machine can download Node.js, with a one-click mirror Orca remembers and retries. Older Windows hosts (Windows 10 1809 and Server 2019) can run Orca's server, and tunnels recover when a port is held by an old SSH connection.
- **Remote servers in Settings:** Remote Orca Servers is one list instead of six sections, and SSH hosts can be removed in bulk and stay removed. Orca tells you when the same server was saved twice, and adding a server you already saved updates it instead.
- **Phone:** Creating a workspace from the phone is much faster, the workspace list stays in step with the desktop, and session tab icons keep their size beside long titles.
- **Editor:** Orca refuses to save over changes made to a file on disk that you haven't seen, and Reload and Undo behave predictably afterwards.
- **Everyday polish:** Projects with the same name on different machines keep short names and show which machine they're on. Long saved conversations use far less memory when Orca scans them for Session History.

---

## Product experience

### SSH, managed servers & remote

*SSH hosts connect in more situations, Remote Orca Servers is one clear list, and edits always go to the machine that owns the workspace.*

* One-click Node.js mirror when neither machine can download Node by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31069
* Retry with the saved Node.js mirror once a running connect fails the same way by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31089
* Ship node-pty's winpty backend so Windows 1809 / Server 2019 hosts can deploy by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31056
* A managed tunnel whose forward can't start takes the stdio bridge, and reclaims a port an old ControlMaster holds by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31062
* A legacy relay restarted at the same socket never takes over an open tab by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31068
* Detect Linux libraries reliably across SSH and WSL by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31077
* Remote Orca Servers: one list instead of six sections; SSH Hosts: bulk remove that stays removed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31082
* Adding a server you already saved updates it instead of saving it twice by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31080
* Say which saved servers are the same machine paired twice, and how to fix it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31100
* Say "Orca on <host>" instead of "managed server" in the UI by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31099
* A moved SSH host lists once in a project's Available Hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31064
* New local projects never dedupe onto an SSH project at the same path by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31055
* PR/MR worktree base refuses SSH projects named only by executionHostId by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31054
* Worktree create sends the host --project/--host selected by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31066
* Editor writes and unqualified removals route by the rows, never the Active Server focus by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31036
* No owner route reads the Active Server focus, so a local row never routes to the focused server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31058
* A damaged browser file list disables only the browser client, not the remote server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31025
* A live orcad's browser helper pauses for macOS desktop installs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31059

### Phone

*Create workspaces from the phone much faster, and keep the phone's workspace list and session tabs accurate.*

* Prepare the worktree checkout while the new-workspace form is open by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31167
* Phone list resends lost option changes, trusts the feed's row facts, and retries a failed feed read by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31088
* Keep session tab icons full size beside long titles by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31169

### Workspaces, sidebar & tabs

*Same-named projects on different machines are easy to tell apart, and the sidebar's agent status and visibility settings stay accurate.*

* Keep project names short and show their machine by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28250
* One agent phase history, so a compaction raises no unread and a title-started turn pushes its finish by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31103
* Visibility settings refresh workspace rows; pre-gap paired-server answers stay unverifiable by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31106

### Editor, files & Markdown

*Saving no longer overwrites changes made on disk behind your back, and previews and renames act on the right file.*

* Refuse saves that would overwrite unnoticed disk changes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30417
* Disk-checked save follow-ups: repeatable stale reloads, Markdown whitespace, Undo of Reload by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31113
* Markdown preview of a terminal-opened file reads with its source tab's grant by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31060
* A rename retargets only editors whose own owner is the renaming host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31091

### Browser

*Browser screenshots from an SSH host are checked when they're taken and when they're answered.*

* An SSH host's capture is admitted at each capture and at its answer by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31072

### Performance & reliability

*Long saved conversations no longer take several times their size in memory while Orca indexes them.*

* [mem] Stream saved transcripts and stage large search writes by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30702

### Relay service

*The hosted relay keeps desktops in their own region and spreads traffic evenly while it is updated.*

* Give region-correction reconnects and roll re-placements the in-region reserve fallback by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31042
* Move director traffic in two steps so a deploy does not land on one instance by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31051
* Let the same-cap trust probe outlast load-balancer warm-up by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31067

### Tests, CI & maintenance

*Faster, lighter builds and checks; the new layout and sidebar work remains behind disabled build switches.*

* Run cell-flags and reserve-watch on the paid runner pool by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31024
* Keep Mac qualification runs out of the release build's concurrency group by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31031
* Build Windows alongside Mac and preserve signing quota by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31032
* Cut end-to-end typecheck memory with Bun by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31046
* Halve CLI compile memory with Bun typechecking by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31043
* Stop the cold-authority scope test depending on the clock by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31098
* Shared switch-on fixtures so 71 layout tests pass with main owning the layout by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31076
* A test-only switch-on server template that packaging refuses by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31097
* No empty extra terminal tab from an old saved terminal record (dark, layout-owner build only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31045
* Agent titles from one status batch reach main as one rename (dark, layout-owner build only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31048
* Main sends one layout update per action, with only what changed (dark, layout-owner build only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31109
* Same-id workspaces on two hosts sort, nest and stay retained on their own; nested groups and project order hold in host sections (dark switch) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31111
* A read Done no longer hides a pane that is still Working in Smart (dark switch) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31114
* Update WeChat QR code for group 13 by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31052

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.232...v1.4.233

name: v1.4.232
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

## The short version

- **Auto permissions, in chat and terminal:** Choose **Manual | Auto | Yolo** in Settings → Agents. Auto lets supported Claude and Codex agents handle approvals, and new native chats follow your choice too. You can choose a separate permission mode for other agents; existing chats keep their own settings.
- **Native chat (experimental):** Open OpenCode 2 directly in chat, find Codex skills by typing `$`, and pan and zoom image previews. Rewind works in long conversations, and usage limits show when they reset with a **Continue** button to pick the conversation back up.
- **A better phone composer:** Attach files as well as photos, insert skills inline, and choose model, effort and permissions from one sheet. Faster recovery after switching apps and more responsive terminal scrolling make it easier to keep working away from your desk.
- **Smoother SSH work:** Managed servers recover from lost pairing over SSH, tunnels follow a restarted server's port, and unsaved editor drafts survive the move to a managed server. File uploads work better over high-latency links, and a configurable Node.js mirror helps on networks that block nodejs.org.
- **More control over your workspace:** Space responds faster, lets you inspect changed files before cleanup, and puts row actions in a dedicated menu. Browser pages can ask for a username and password, and Orca asks before a page opens another app.
- **A lighter app and faster Mac updates:** Shared desktop and browser assets, fewer duplicate resources and smaller tour animations reduce the app's footprint. macOS updates avoid background installer throttling, helping Orca get back to your work sooner.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

**Native chat (experimental):** Some chat features require support from the remote host. Keep paired and SSH hosts updated alongside Orca to use the latest capabilities.

**Auto permissions:** Availability depends on the agent, model and host version. Changing the default applies to new sessions; existing native chats retain their saved permissions.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*OpenCode 2 opens in chat, Codex and Pi skills are easier to find, image previews support pan and zoom, and long conversations are easier to resume and rewind. Usage limits explain the pause and offer Continue, while sent images and visuals stay with the chat.*

### Agents, accounts & permissions

name: Orca Mobile Android mobile-android-v0.0.58
body:
Thank you for using Orca mobile! ❤️

## What's new

- With more than one computer connected, tapping Tasks on the home screen asks which computer to open it on.
- Reconnects faster when you switch back to the app.
- If Orca on your computer is too old to serve a screen, the app asks you to update it instead of showing an older version of that screen.

Most phone features come from your desktop, so update Orca on your computer to get everything. See the [desktop release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) for the full list.

Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

## The short version

- **Native chat (experimental):** Use Antigravity in chat, choose which agents open as chats, and install a missing agent from the chat itself. Paste copied files as attachments, queue images, and see clearer feedback while attachments and queue actions are pending.
- **Accounts & agents:** After switching Claude accounts, restart running sessions on the new account. Remove downloaded agent runtimes from Settings, and edit or delete Linear comments through the Orca CLI.
- **Phone:** Edit queued messages in place, follow tool runs with desktop-style cards, and see your conversation immediately when resuming from history. Landscape phones put session tabs in the top bar, and Tasks makes clear which desktop you’re using.
- **SSH & remote workspaces:** Disconnect stays disconnected, sleeping workspaces stay asleep, and closed tabs stay closed after reconnecting. Clearer server update and re-pairing messages help you recover a connection.
- **Everyday polish:** Quick Command shortcuts follow the focused split, tab previews wait for the full hover delay, and file headers offer Reveal in Finder. Workspace cleanup better protects same-path projects on other machines.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

**Native chat (experimental):** Some chat features require support from the remote host. Keep the host updated alongside Orca to use the latest capabilities.

**The `orca` command on SSH hosts:** Existing hosts retain explicitly saved CLI control preferences; an unset preference is migrated to off. To allow commands on a connected SSH host to open and control this desktop’s Orca browser tabs for that host’s workspaces, enable **Allow this host’s orca CLI to control Orca** under Settings → SSH Hosts → edit the host → Advanced Connection.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Choose which agents open as chats, use Antigravity, attach files and images more reliably, and see clearer queue, model and input-ownership feedback.*

* Offer Install when a chat’s host is missing the agent it needs by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29051
* Chat: dropped files hold Send until they're attached by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29173
* A queue action still on its way greys its controls, like the phone by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29120
* Image messages wait in the queue like text by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28655
* Chat: pasting a copied file attaches it, like dropping it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29089
* Choose which agents open in native chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29071
* A sign-in prompt on an ACP agent's error output ends the start or turn signed out by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28467
* An agent can run each chat's own permission mode itself by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28455
* Hide Orca's chat-naming requests from Session History by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30029
* A running Claude chat keeps its model when two Claude Code versions list differently by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30022
* Use Antigravity in native chat through its ACP server by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28595
* A refused steer leaves its turn as the chat's latest request by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29907
* A Codex chat is Working only while Codex holds the send by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29922
* Pause an agent's chat starts while its shared sign-in changes by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28649
* The queue button you pressed shows a working spinner by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30010
* Mark each attached image as [Image #N] where it sits in the prompt by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28736
* Keep a restored agent’s status unconfirmed after 30 minutes instead of marking it done by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30186
* Show why the chat composer is locked and offer Take back when a phone holds the input by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30199
* Antigravity install: one clear message in the chat, with the message box staying in place by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30001
* Session History: the scan line under the search box no longer jumps during a refresh by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30158
* Sign in to Antigravity chats with the server’s own Google sign-in by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28650
* Move a chat visual's Open and Share buttons above it by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30356
* A Claude chat keeps a model its CLI stopped listing by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30436

### Agents, integrations & accounts

*Switch Claude accounts with a restart offer, manage downloaded runtimes, edit Linear comments, and keep terminal sessions and GitLab task searches reliable.*

* Edit and delete Linear comments from the Orca CLI by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30003
* Remove a downloaded agent runtime from its Settings row by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29140
* Follow an Orca Claude account switch when the shell sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29890
* Offer to restart running Claude sessions on the new account after a switch by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29898
* Remove a downloaded agent runtime only after nothing on its host can still run it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29139
* Let jcode's own client start its per-pane server by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30257
* Run the Antigravity usage check with agy's auto-update off by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30387
* Quit no longer warns about terminals a paired Orca server keeps running by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30006
* Resume a relaunched workspace's sleeping agents only when shown by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29459
* One spawn step writes a terminal's pane identity for both ways Orca opens terminals by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29884
* Tell users once that the diff panel in a Claude pane is Claude's own by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29818
* Keep OMP prompt markers from ending an agent’s turn so phone chat can find its session by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30273
* Avoid duplicate snapshot replays after reveal by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30205
* Keep OMP prompt markers from triggering unnecessary terminal repair by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30285
* Limit concurrent GitLab project requests to keep task searches within the queue limit by @maxmilian in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30157

### SSH, managed servers & remote

*Keep disconnects, sleeping workspaces and closed tabs consistent, preserve workspace identity during server moves, and recover with clearer update and re-pairing guidance.*

* Stop suggesting --host to listings that reject it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30012
* Explain why file open fails on a server with no app window by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30014
* A host converted to its managed server keeps its workspaces' visit recency by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30015
* Link a folder workspace the server kept when a re-created SSH host moves again (#27285) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30017
* A password SSH host waits for you at launch instead of prompting by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30025
* Make the host's tab name the one source for CLI and desktop renames by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30037
* A slept remote workspace stays asleep through terminal orphan recovery by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30118
* A Disconnect stays disconnected, and Settings and the status bar agree by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30130
* Orca serve on orcad serves the browser client and answers plain HTTP by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30120
* A tab closed while a managed host is disconnected stays closed; deflake the shared-home spec by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30146
* Paired clients see a folder-upgraded Git project under the host workspace id by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30190
* Move the open workspace to the server's linked project when joining an existing server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30189
* Saved terminal history no longer blocks a host's move to its Orca server (#30126) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30188
* Say when a managed server may be behind this app, and retry a failed update once per launch by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30218
* A late relay-era attach releases only its own viewer, never a successor's by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30219
* Report a legacy relay host active once a day while it bridges terminals by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30229
* SSH host management on a server without the desktop app says why it can't (D3) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30242
* A connection never redials a host the user disconnected before its teardown runs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30245
* Refuse a migration request too large for the host's sealed frame before sending it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30249
* Overlapping update checks never both try a host the first one just failed on by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30253
* Show Re-pair required for revoked servers and let you re-pair in place by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30271

### Phone

*Edit queued messages in place, follow tool runs, resume conversations with their history visible, and navigate files, Tasks and landscape session tabs more smoothly.*

* Edit queued messages in place by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28646
* One Working line in every chat; drop the floating 'Agent is working' pill by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29972
* The chat's Working line uses desktop's spinner by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30008
* Keep a headless host's chat tab through snapshot rebuilds by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30028
* Prevent markdown and file tab reload and screen flicker on retap and revisit by @zhangxaochen in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30033
* Show the update screen instead of native screens when the desktop has no page by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29956
* Allow Markdown refresh during desktop tab snapshots by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30040
* Draw the host Accounts screen from the desktop's page by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30020
* Ask which desktop to open Tasks on when several are connected by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30048
* Show which desktop the mobile Tasks screen is for by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30105
* A compact phone queue: shorter header, a capped scrolling list, and an editor that fits the card by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30016
* Draw chat tool runs the way desktop does by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30135
* Render Source Control on the phone for large branches by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30215
* A session resumed from the phone's history shows its conversation before the first new turn (#10923) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30283
* Break the transport and terminal-document import cycles, and gate cycles after mobile's install by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30290
* Put the session tabs in the top bar on a landscape phone by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29070

### Workspaces, sidebar & tabs

*Protect same-path workspaces on different machines, explain cross-host actions, keep shortcuts on the focused split, and make notices and tab previews steadier.*

* Main produces per-workspace activity facts, checked against the window in dev and test by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29980
* Stop the notice stack flickering under a resting mouse, and fit the force-delete button to its notice by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29878
* ResolveOwner refuses folder and project-group twins instead of guessing this computer by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30009
* Main publishes desktop focus, pins, project and host order, and SSH/WSL host state, checked against the window in dev and test by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30018

name: v1.4.229
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

## The short version

- **Native chat (experimental):** Review turn-by-turn edits inline, expand diagrams to pan and zoom, share chat visuals with a click, and see Claude goals and Codex context usage. Keyboard answers, an unread divider and Copy on Select make long conversations easier to navigate.
- **Shared skills:** Shared-skill installation now supports 20 additional agents, with broader WSL discovery and the right install locations for tools such as Kiro, Qoder and CodeBuddy.
- **Phone:** Workspace filters, grouping and sorting now follow the desktop’s shared choices. Long-press for linked issues and notes, work with server workspaces and browser pages, or continue a supported chat in a new terminal conversation.
- **SSH and remote terminals:** Reconnect fixes preserve split panes, paste order and managed-server project groups. Sleeping agents resume their conversations, and removing one machine’s project leaves its same-path counterpart alone.
- **Workspaces and everyday polish:** Open a website from Cmd/Ctrl+J, watch checkout progress as a worktree is created, and clean up workspaces with an explicit confirmation before stopping running agents.
- **Jira planning:** Switch between issue lists and boards, focus on the current sprint, reuse saved JQL and Jira favourites, and start workspaces from desktop or phone. Your agents can read and update Jira tickets through the Orca CLI, too.

## Known issues

**Native chat (experimental):** Features that depend on a remote host are available when that host supports them. Update the host alongside Orca to get the latest capabilities.

**The `orca` command on SSH hosts:** Existing hosts keep their saved Orca CLI control preference. To let agents there manage workspaces or control the desktop browser, turn on **Allow this host’s orca CLI to control Orca** under Settings → SSH Hosts → edit the host → Advanced Connection.

---

## Product experience

### Automations

*Create and edit automations on SSH projects with older paired servers, and keep scheduled work attached to the right host.*

### Performance & reliability

*Reduce repeated status subscriptions and session-stream work, avoid blocking WSL checks, and make workspace creation and switching smoother.*

The remaining changes are listed in the [complete release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/download/v1.4.229/orca-v1.4.229-complete-changelog.md), with every title and contributor credit.
