name: v1.4.227
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

## The short version

- **Native chats have their own permission mode.** Choose permissions for each new Claude or Codex chat from Settings → Chat → Behavior; existing chats keep the mode they were already using, and changing models no longer resets it.
- **Native chat sessions are easier to continue.** You can resume large terminal conversations in a new native chat, recover chats whose only work ran in the background after a restart, and see every supported chat provider accurately in Session History.
- **Claude accounts and Codex chat setup are smoother.** Claude accounts again use separate folders, the sign-in link can be copied, Codex chats require version 0.136.0 or later, and Codex Ultrafast is available as a speed choice.
- **Browser automation gives your keyboard back reliably.** Agent browser commands target the intended page, and browser popups behave more like Chrome.
- **Also:** worktree cleanup is safer, read macOS notifications disappear from Notification Center, long chats load better on phones, and cold session-history reads avoid unnecessary reindexing.

---

## Product experience

### UI / workspace

*Safer worktree cleanup, tidier macOS notifications and small translation cleanup.*
* fix(worktrees): never delete a folder git no longer tracks by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25075
* fix(notifications): remove read macOS notifications from Notification Center by pane thread by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28425
* fix(i18n): drop chat-mode keys removed from en.json in #28113 by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28131

### Orchestration

*Retries no longer leave failed worker starts piling up as live agents.*
* fix(orchestration): stop retried failed worker starts from piling up live agents by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27795

### Agents / native chat

*Each Claude and Codex chat keeps its own permission mode, chats are easier to resume and manage, Claude accounts return with safer sign-in, and chat settings and model handling are more consistent.*
* feat(native-chat): each Claude/Codex chat gets its own permission mode by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26116
* fix(native-chat): chats from before permission modes keep the mode they were running with by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28099
* fix(native-chat): seed the chat permission default from Claude's and Codex's own arguments by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28100
* feat(settings): move Permissions for new chats into the Chat page's Behavior section by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28212
* fix(native-chat): store a chat's permission mode on its own, so a model pick can't reset it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28268
* feat(native-chat): require Codex 0.136.0 for chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26684
* feat(native-chat): offer Codex Ultrafast as a speed choice by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26962
* Re-land Claude per-account folders (#24434, #26405) with the upgrade and proxy fixes by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26801
* Add "Copy sign-in link instead" for Claude accounts (STA-9912) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26990
* fix(native-chat): offer resume after restart for chats whose only work was in the background by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27167
* fix(native-chat): resume large terminal conversations in a new native chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29056
* Terminal header button: Resume in New Native Chat replaces Show chat view by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27184
* fix(tab-bar): offer Resume in New Native Chat only while the tab's agent is running by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27520
* Session History shows OpenCode, Grok, OMP and Pi chats as chats and refuses a second terminal writer by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27183
* Session History: resume folder workspace chats in their own folder by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27209
* Resume dialog: show a finished resume as a result, not a picker by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27732
* Save a new chat's first message during create by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26332
* fix(native-chat): settle a reply cut off by a server restart by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26460
* Open a chat visual in its own tab instead of the sidebar by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26728
* Let a Codex chat stop a command it left running in the background by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26780
* fix(native-chat): preserve running subagent rows in long chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26798
* A new Pi chat names the model it will run on its first frame by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26821
* Keep Chat UI users with a Terminal default on the terminal, with a chat mode switch in the upgrade tip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26915
* Floating-workspace chats of every native-chat agent keep links in the folder they started in by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26981
* Every agent reports its learned default model once, when a chat starts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26982
* Let a Grok chat list and stop the commands it left running in the background by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27022
* Let a Codex chat stop a sub-agent from the background-tasks strip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27026
* fix(native-chat): a new chat's model and effort pickers match their first frame before the agent starts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27031
* Native chat: every agent launches through one composed launch path by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27204
* Edit agent launch settings on the workspace host by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26479
* One shared subagent tracker for Claude, Codex and Grok chat rows by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27228
* Native chat: read one saved row per subagent (part 1 of 2) by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27914
* feat(chat): host writes one saved row per subagent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27947
* feat(settings): move Chat UI's chat settings from Experimental to the Chat page by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28050
* fix(tab-bar): native chat tabs show their recorded provider, not one guessed from the title by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28082
* Replace chat upgrade switch with primary Enable Now button by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28113
* Make Enable Now the full-width action in the chat upgrade tip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28199

### Remote server / SSH

*Paired devices are identified by their device ID instead of a credential.*
* native chat: identify a paired device by its device id, never its credential by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26777

### Browser

*Popups follow Chrome’s behavior more closely, while agent browser actions stay focused on the intended page and return the keyboard when they finish.*
* Open links and window.open in Orca tabs the way Chrome does by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26976
* Fix browser login popups and menu actions in native windows by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28474
* Auto-hide menu bar in web popups and re-layout when revealed by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28388
* fix(browser): agent bringToFront and activateTarget no longer take your keyboard (1/3) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28452
* fix(browser): agent keys and text go to the page, never into your terminal (2/3) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28453
* fix(browser): agent clicks give your keyboard back (3/3) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28454
* fix(browser): require a target for ambiguous keypress commands by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28221
* fix(browser): refuse web pages on the agent-browser CDP proxy by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27415

### GitHub / source control

*AI commit messages now start from the same shell environment that chats use.*
* Start AI commit messages from the same shell environment chats use by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26808

### Performance

*Windows notifications no longer freeze Orca, and cold session-history reads skip unchanged transcript reindexing.*
* perf(notifications): stop every Windows notification from freezing Orca by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27731
* Skip reindexing unchanged transcripts on cold session list reads by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28798

### Mobile

*Long chats preserve each update within its limit, remember the reader’s place, and open every supported native-chat provider on the phone.*
* fix(native-chat): load long chats on the phone by keeping every update within its limit by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28203
* fix(mobile): keep the chat where the reader scrolled to by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28413
* fix(mobile): open Grok, OpenCode, OMP and Pi chats on the phone by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27212

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.224...v1.4.227

name: Orca Mobile Android mobile-android-v0.0.57
body:
Thank you for using Orca mobile! ❤️

## What's new

- Downloading the latest app from your computer keeps going over slow connections, such as Tailscale or a weak signal, instead of failing partway.
- Opening a workspace no longer downloads the app again when nothing has changed on your computer.

Most phone features come from your desktop, so update Orca on your computer to get everything. See the [desktop release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) for the full list.

name: Orca Mobile Android mobile-android-v0.0.55
body:
Thank you for using Orca mobile! ❤️

## Over-the-air updates

The Orca app on your phone now gets most of its screens and features from the desktop it's paired with, instead of having them built into the app. When you update Orca on your computer, the phone picks up the new version the next time it connects.

- **New features sooner.** Phone improvements ship with each desktop release. You don't have to wait for an App Store or Play Store update.
- **Phone and desktop always match.** The phone runs the version your desktop serves, so features and fixes line up and nothing breaks because one side is newer.
- **Fewer app updates.** You only need to update the app itself occasionally.

You'll see a short "Downloading the latest app" screen the first time you connect to a computer, and again after you update Orca there. After that, the app opens right away.

## What's new

- When the app downloads the latest version from your computer, a progress bar shows how far along it is, and downloads finish faster.
- Grok, OpenCode, OMP and Pi chats now open on the phone, and chat visuals and subagents show inline like on desktop.
- Messages you send while an agent is working wait above the composer and go out in order. A message that couldn't be delivered is marked "Not sent" and goes back to your draft.
- Answer an agent's questions with number keys.
- SSH hosts show their connection health on the workspace list, and the list follows the desktop's pinned-workspace setting.
- Videos and music files play in file previews.
- Pairing links are more secure, and scanning a new code replaces an old pairing.
- Lower memory use, smoother chat scrolling on Android, and more reliable terminals.

Most phone features come from your desktop, so update Orca on your computer to get everything. See the [desktop release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) for the full list.

name: v1.4.224
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

## The short version

- **Automations can now set the agent's model and effort for each run.** In the automation editor, open Advanced and fill in **Extra agent arguments** (or use `--extra-agent-args` with `orca automations create` and `edit`), for example `-model haiku --effort high`. This works today for Claude, Codex, Grok and CodeBuddy (model and effort), Cursor (model, which carries its effort) and OMP (model), and support for more agents is coming soon. Each run starts a fresh session, and your other automations keep the host's defaults. Separately, scheduled runs in an existing workspace on an Orca server now hand the task to agents that read it after they start, such as Aider, Goose and Amp, instead of leaving them idle.
- **SSH hosts now run a managed Orca server.** Orca ships its own runtime and sets it up when you connect, so connections no longer fail because a host has the wrong Node version or no build tools. A host with no open terminals switches on its next connect and brings its projects, folders and open editor tabs along. A host with open terminals keeps working as before and offers **Move to a managed Orca server**, which restarts those terminals. A host that can't run it keeps its current connection, and Settings → SSH Hosts says why. You can see, update, roll back, **Recover** or **Forget** each server in Settings → Managed servers.
- **Native chat (experimental):** If you turned on Chat UI with chat as your default view, supported agents now open in the structured chat by default. If Terminal was your default, new agent tabs stay in the terminal, and a one-time tip explains the change and lets you turn chat mode on. You can move a conversation between chat and a terminal from the tab's right-click menu or from Agent Session History (**Resume in New CLI** / **Resume in New Native Chat**).
- **More in native chat:** Recent versions of OpenCode (including 2.x), Pi and OMP open as structured chats on this computer. Agents can draw charts, diagrams and mockups right inside a reply, on desktop and phone (switch it off under Settings → Chat → Inline visuals). Cmd/Ctrl+F searches a chat, you can quote part of a reply with **Add to chat**, Up/Down recalls every prompt you sent, number keys answer an agent's questions, and long messages and runs of tool calls fold into one row. The model picker no longer waits for the agent to start, Codex and Pi say they're signed out before you send, and a reply Orca had to cut off says why and offers **Continue**. Grok shows its subagents, and Grok, OpenCode and OMP can `/compact`.
- **SSH and remote terminals:** Keys you type during a network outage arrive exactly once and in order, scrollback and pane size survive a reconnect, and open tabs reattach after a managed server update. Shell startup files that print text, folders with tens of thousands of entries and 64-bit ARM Linux servers no longer break or drop the connection. Files, browser tabs, links and drag-and-drop stay on the machine they belong to when two machines share a path. `orca serve` now loads its SSH hosts, and quitting a window on a serving machine no longer stops the server.
- **Phone:** A browser tab opened on the phone loads while the desktop is minimized or in its screen saver, chat visuals and subagents show in the phone's native chat, and videos and music files play in previews.
- **Workspaces and editing:** You can attach several pull requests, merge requests and tasks to one workspace. Hovering a tab shows its full title with icon and program, Force Delete can remember **Always force delete**, and **Continue in New Session** is now **Hand Off to Another Agent**. Markdown shows GitHub-style callouts such as `> [!NOTE]`, PDFs zoom with pinch and Cmd/Ctrl+`=`/`-`, and files dragged in from Finder or File Explorer land in the exact pane, folder or editor you drop them on.
- **Also:** The usage meters in the status bar now default to a shorter Compact view unless you chose one (Detailed is still available), Stage All stages every change even when the list is capped at 1,000, and Orca detects the GitHub CLI even when a `gh` launcher hangs.

## Known issues

**The `orca` command on SSH hosts:** By default, `orca` commands run on an SSH host reach only that host's own terminals and orchestration messages. To let agents there create worktrees, open terminals or dispatch work through `orca`, turn on **Allow this host's orca CLI to control Orca** for that host (Settings → SSH Hosts → edit the host → Advanced Connection) (#26483).

**Downgrading to v1.4.223:** Terminals started in v1.4.224 can't be reached from v1.4.223 until you update again. Extra pull requests, merge requests and tasks you attached to a folder workspace are removed. If Chat UI was on, it may be off after you update again; turn it back on in Settings → Experimental. SSH hosts that moved to a managed server work over the old connection in v1.4.223; if you add or remove projects there, the host shows "Changed on an older Orca" after you update and offers **Move the new projects**. Orca still refuses to install versions older than v1.4.214 from its version picker. To go back to one of those, run `orca profile state rollback --latest-json` with Orca closed, then install the old version by hand (#23262).

**Terminals after updating:** This version starts a new terminal background service for new terminals. Terminals that were already open keep running on the previous one, so changes in this release apply only to terminals opened after the update.

**Native chats from v1.4.217 or older:** If you used native chat (experimental) on v1.4.217 or older and update straight to v1.4.224, your earlier native chats won't appear. Their files stay on disk (#26038).

**Relaunching from shell history:** When an agent's launch command is long or spans several lines, the shell history holds a short one-time line instead, so pressing up-arrow and Enter does not start the agent again (#23962).

**Workspaces created from the phone:** Creating a workspace from an issue, pull request or Linear item with an agent on the phone still moves the desktop to that workspace (#26025).

**Windows on ARM:** The ARM64 package ships an x64 `orca.exe` command-line tool. Windows 11 on ARM runs it under emulation. Windows 10 on ARM can't run it, so the `orca` command does not work there (#24094).

**OpenCode 2:** If you update from v1.4.219 or earlier, OpenCode 2 panes that were already running may show no status until you restart OpenCode in them. If you downgrade Orca after updating, duplicate OpenCode status plugins are left behind. After `opencode run` exits, its pane can keep showing "Done"; a fix is pending in #24472.

**Claude folder trust:** Folder pre-trust is on by default (Settings → Agents → "Trust the folder when Orca starts an agent"). On Alpine WSL, Orca can't copy the file permissions it needs, so Claude shows its own trust prompt instead (#23744).

name: v1.4.223
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

Orca Server 2.0 is coming soon, with improvements to make remote work more reliable. The current Remote Server remains experimental and may have bugs.

## The short version

- **Native chat (experimental):** With "Use updated structured native chat" turned on (Settings → Chat UI), Grok now opens as a structured chat on this computer and on paired Orca servers; SSH and WSL keep the terminal chat. You can rewind a conversation to an earlier message, search the model list, pick workspace files by typing `@`, and set text size, code size, width and contrast, or match your terminal, on a new Settings → Chat page. Chats are named after their first message, alert you when they stop to ask for approval, keep an unsent draft through a reload or quit, and use the Command and Arguments saved in Settings → Agents. Claude chats now open for API-key users, and Windows chats no longer refuse to start.
- **SSH workspaces:** Open files, live agent tabs and paused Claude or Codex resume offers survive an SSH reconnect and a restart, and tabs you closed long ago no longer come back as empty shells. Clicking an SSH worktree whose last tab you closed opens a terminal again.
- **Remote servers and the phone:** A paired terminal accepts typing again after its host app relaunches, remote browser tabs come back after a network drop, and the phone keeps every terminal after `orca serve` restarts. Starting an agent from the phone shows its tab right away and no longer moves your desktop window; creating a workspace on a remote host no longer pulls other connected desktops to it.
- **Agents and terminals:** Long or multi-line agent launch commands on macOS and Linux reach the agent whole instead of being cut off or run line by line, and startup commands now use a real Enter. A pane you close just before quitting no longer comes back, and a pane dragged into its own tab no longer appears in two tabs. Claude's spinner clears when you cancel with Escape, and Codex keeps its working status when Escape only closes search. Orca no longer rewrites your `~/.codex` hooks on every Codex launch, and helper processes it starts for Claude, Codex and OpenCode stop when Orca quits or crashes.
- **Accounts and agents:** Switching Claude accounts keeps your MCP server sign-ins. Pi and OMP show their background helpers as rows, Rovo Dev is detected through `acli`, and Grok 4.7 is in the model list.
- **Sidebar and workspaces:** Orca remembers whether the left sidebar was open. The agent activity view gets filters, a right-click menu and multi-select. A workspace that contains nested worktrees can be deleted together with them, in the background. Revealing a remote workspace no longer expands your local sections, and the Dock badge clears when you visit the workspace.
- **Files and search:** Audio and video files play in Orca. Quarto and R Markdown files are highlighted. You can reveal a changed file in Source Control, or a file path in a terminal, in Finder or File Explorer. Quick Open matches multi-part queries and opens files at the requested location, and abandoned searches stop.
- **Tasks and review:** GitHub Projects Board views show as a kanban you can drag cards across, private Linear images in task descriptions load, and GitLab merge request and issue actions in SSH workspaces reach the right server.
- **Also:** A completion sound now plays for an agent that finishes right after another, and screenshot markup has an eraser.

## Known issues

**Native chats from v1.4.217 or older** *(release manager: drop this item if it does not apply)*: If you used native chat (experimental) on v1.4.217 or older and update straight to v1.4.223, your earlier native chats won't appear. Their files stay on disk (#26038).

**Terminals after updating:** This version starts a new terminal background service for new terminals. Terminals that were already open keep running on the previous one, so changes such as whole long launch commands apply only to terminals opened after the update. This also means the OpenCode, Pi and Qoder detection improvements from v1.4.222 now work in new terminals without restarting anything.

**Relaunching from shell history:** When an agent's launch command is long or spans several lines, the shell history holds a short one-time line instead, so pressing up-arrow and Enter does not start the agent again (#23962).

**Workspaces created from the phone:** Creating a workspace from an issue, pull request or Linear item with an agent on the phone still moves the desktop to that workspace (#26025).

**Downgrading:** Orca now refuses to install versions older than v1.4.214 from its version picker. To go back to one of those, run `orca profile state rollback --latest-json` with Orca closed, then install the old version by hand (#23262).

**Windows on ARM:** The ARM64 package ships an x64 `orca.exe` command-line tool. Windows 11 on ARM runs it under emulation. Windows 10 on ARM can't run it, so the `orca` command does not work there (#24094).

**OpenCode 2:** If you update from v1.4.219 or earlier, OpenCode 2 panes that were already running may show no status until you restart OpenCode in them. If you downgrade Orca after updating, duplicate OpenCode status plugins are left behind. After `opencode run` exits, its pane can keep showing "Done"; a fix is pending in #24472.

**Claude folder trust:** Folder pre-trust is on by default (Settings → Agents → "Trust the folder when Orca starts an agent"). On Alpine WSL, Orca can't copy the file permissions it needs, so Claude shows its own trust prompt instead (#23744).

---

### Native chat (experimental)

*Grok can run as a structured chat, you can rewind a conversation, search models, mention files with @ and tune how chats look, chats get names and approval alerts, drafts and Stops keep your text, and chats start more reliably for Codex, API-key Claude users, Windows and custom agent commands.*

name: v1.4.222
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

Orca Server 2.0 is coming soon, with improvements to make remote work more reliable. The current Remote Server remains experimental and may have bugs.

## The short version

- **OpenCode workers:** A worker started with `orca orchestration worker-start --agent opencode` no longer leaves its task sitting unsent in OpenCode's input box on a busy machine; Orca now waits until OpenCode can actually submit it. A worker can use a requested model without changing the default for your other launches, OpenCode 2.0.12 sends its first prompt on its own, and Orca's OpenCode plugin is installed where that terminal's OpenCode actually reads its settings.
- **Sidebar and workspaces:** A remote computer you reveal in the sidebar no longer disappears again while Orca saves the setting. Dragging a workspace whose children are collapsed now moves it, dragging workspaces can no longer crash the sidebar, the delete dialog stops jumping while its checks load, and Create worktree closes right away while setup scripts are checked in the background.
- **CSV files:** Large CSV files open without loading the whole file at once. You can resize columns, open links, edit cells, add or remove rows and columns, copy and paste ranges, and sort or filter, and column widths are remembered.
- **Editor:** Tabs for files outside your projects no longer come back as "Access denied" after a restart. Files with the same path on different computers keep separate text and Undo history. Image pastes and large Markdown pastes land where you started them, and notebook cells pick up changes made on disk.
- **Typing in Japanese, Chinese or Korean:** Pressing Enter to confirm text no longer also submits the field, creates the file, or sends the comment, across Orca.
- **Native chat (experimental):** Opening a chat never deletes its history, even one saved by a newer Orca. Messages show "Sending…" until the host confirms them and "Not sent" with the reason if delivery failed. Stop only marks the turn it actually stopped, a failed start no longer blocks new chats, the model list comes from the machine that runs the chat, and a reply cut off by a crash or quit reads as finished with one explanation.
- **Agents and accounts:** The usage menu shows Claude usage credits, OpenCode Zen balance and Codex credits next to usage limits. Restart after switching Codex accounts resumes the same conversation instead of leaving a blank terminal. A saved model pick and a configured agent argument no longer send the same flag twice and stop the agent from starting, and Cursor usage reads the right account.
- **Remote terminals:** Coming back to a remote tab running Claude Code no longer shows old shell output through Claude's screen.
- **Jira:** You can pick the assignee when creating a Jira issue.

## Known issues

**Agent detection after updating:** If you update from v1.4.221, improvements to OpenCode, Pi, and Qoder detection take effect after the terminal background service restarts. Existing terminals keep running through the update.

**Windows on ARM:** The ARM64 package ships an x64 `orca.exe` command-line tool. Windows 11 on ARM runs it under emulation. Windows 10 on ARM can't run it, so the `orca` command does not work there (#24094).

**OpenCode 2:** If you update from v1.4.219 or earlier, OpenCode 2 panes that were already running may show no status until you restart OpenCode in them. If you downgrade Orca after updating, duplicate OpenCode status plugins are left behind. After `opencode run` exits, its pane can keep showing "Done"; a fix is pending in #24472.

**Codex:** After you upgrade, Codex launches use Orca's managed Codex home until Codex approves Orca's new status hook. A resumed pane that uses `~/.codex` can pause for up to 30 seconds (#23552).

**Claude folder trust:** Folder pre-trust is on by default (Settings → Agents → "Trust the folder when Orca starts an agent"). On Alpine WSL, Orca can't copy the file permissions it needs, so Claude shows its own trust prompt instead (#23744).

---

### Codex & orchestration

*OpenCode workers receive their task once OpenCode can submit it and can use their own model, long launch prompts from the phone are pasted once the agent is ready, and switching Codex accounts resumes the same conversation.*

name: v1.4.221
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

Remote Server is an experimental feature and may have bugs. Remote Server 2.0 is coming this week and will eliminate most of them.

## The short version

- **Security fix for Copilot:** When Orca marked a folder as trusted for GitHub Copilot, it could leave `~/.copilot/config.json` readable by other users on the same machine. That file can hold your Copilot login tokens. v1.4.219 and v1.4.220 did this on SSH hosts too, where other people often share the machine. The file is now owner-only after Orca writes to it. A file an older Orca already opened up is fixed the next time Orca adds a new folder to it.
- **Codex on Windows uses your own `~/.codex`:** Codex in Orca now uses the same folder as Codex outside Orca, as it already did on macOS and Linux. If you only signed in inside Orca, that sign-in is copied over so you stay logged in. Codex may ask again to trust a folder or approve a command, and MCP servers you added only inside Orca need to be added again; a one-time message explains this. Codex terminals that were open before the update keep working on Orca's old folder, keep their Orca-only MCP servers, and no longer show a restart dialog.
- **Codex workers:** `worker-start` now accepts `max` and `ultra` effort for Codex models Orca doesn't list yet, such as the gpt-6.x models, instead of refusing them.
- **More agents and accounts:** Qoder conversations appear in session history and search, Orca can launch Qoder CLI China and Qwen Code, and GLM Coding Plans can be linked without ZCode. OpenCode and Devin can keep separate account profiles, Antigravity gets an Accounts card, and Antigravity IDE and 2.0 conversations can continue in a new CLI conversation.
- **Native chat (experimental):** Workspaces on a paired Orca server open structured chats when chat is your default. OpenCode sessions can use Chat. A Claude subagent waiting on a permission prompt reads as waiting, and chat errors use plain wording without loading flashes or duplicate reports.
- **Agent status and orchestration:** Codex's "Implement this plan?" menu and open agent questions now count as waiting on you, so sent text no longer lands on the menu. OMP 18.4 workers start, and an agent now uses Orca's own `orca` command even when shell startup files put an older global install first.
- **Files, Markdown and search:** Semicolon-separated CSVs show as columns. Large Markdown previews load faster, Find in them opens faster, and oversized tables are readable. Typing with Find open no longer jumps the caret. Search finds the right files and tells you when it couldn't finish, and file updates recover after SSH reconnects or replaced folders.
- **Workspaces and notifications:** Desktop notifications can be turned off per machine. A worktree delete that git can't finish stays listed so you can retry, and workspaces in WSL-runtime projects on `C:\` can be deleted again. Create PR asks your agent to write the PR details on an already pushed branch, and Jira search accepts plain words.
- **Updates and memory:** On macOS, Update & Restart no longer closes Orca and then waits forever on background Orca servers; Orca tells you what to close and lets you retry. Many fixes let Orca free memory held by closed tabs, previews, phone screens and idle caches.

**Terminals you already had open:** Updating starts a new terminal background service. Terminals open before the update keep running on the previous one. New terminals use the new service and get this release's terminal fixes, including the `orca` command fix above, OpenCode and Devin account profiles, and agent detection and resume for jcode, Qoder CLI China, Qwen Code and Cursor.

## Known issues

**Windows on ARM:** The ARM64 package ships an x64 `orca.exe` command-line tool. Windows 11 on ARM runs it under emulation. Windows 10 on ARM can't run it, so the `orca` command does not work there (#24094).

**OpenCode 2:** If you update from v1.4.219 or earlier, OpenCode 2 panes that were already running may show no status until you restart OpenCode in them. If you downgrade Orca after updating, duplicate OpenCode status plugins are left behind. After `opencode run` exits, its pane can keep showing "Done"; a fix is pending in #24472.

**OpenCode workers:** On a busy machine, an OpenCode worker started with `orca orchestration worker-start`, or an OpenCode tab launched with a prompt, can occasionally leave its task sitting unsent in OpenCode's input box. Pressing Enter in that pane sends it. A fix (#25101) is on main and will ship in a later release.

**Codex:** After you upgrade, Codex launches use Orca's managed Codex home until Codex approves Orca's new status hook. A resumed pane that uses `~/.codex` can pause for up to 30 seconds (#23552).

**Claude folder trust:** Folder pre-trust is on by default (Settings → Agents → "Trust the folder when Orca starts an agent"). On Alpine WSL, Orca can't copy the file permissions it needs, so Claude shows its own trust prompt instead (#23744).

---

## Product experience

### Codex & orchestration

*Codex on Windows now runs on your own `~/.codex` without a restart prompt for terminals you already had open, Codex workers accept max and ultra effort on newer models, and orchestration recognizes Codex's plan menu, open agent questions and OMP 18.4.*

### Agents, accounts & integrations

*Copilot's settings file stays private, Qoder, Qwen Code and GLM Coding Plans join the supported agents and accounts, OpenCode and Devin can keep separate account profiles, and Antigravity, Cursor, OpenCode and jcode integrations are more reliable.*

name: v1.4.220
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

This patch is built from the October 2 daily build plus fixes picked from main. Pull requests that landed on main after that are not in this build.

## The short version

- **Native chat (experimental):** The **"Stop" button** ends Claude's process, including background commands and subagents. If Codex refuses or never answers a stop request, Orca ends it too. Unsent messages stay unsent until Retry, steered messages are not duplicated, and interrupted turns show a clearer status.
- **Chat polish:** `/clear` switches chats immediately; the first message starts the new agent. Codex connection retries update one warning instead of stacking errors. You can send AI notes to open chats, and older Orca versions preserve newer chat histories as read-only.
- **Agent status:** Esc cancellation settles Codex panes promptly, while Ctrl+C used to copy or leave `/side` no longer looks like an interruption. OpenCode shows failed and stopped turns correctly. Slow SSH connections no longer make agents look gone.
- **Usage meters:** Antigravity shows its own quota without Gemini CLI sign-in or spending quota to check. Cursor sign-in checks no longer freeze on large databases or mistake a refused usage request for an expired login.
- **Workspaces:** Creation is faster in large repositories, removal no longer stalls chat or files, and a workspace finishing in the background no longer switches your view. Local `main` updates are safer, and sidebar host tags can be hidden.
- **SSH hosts:** An optional Orca runtime works without Node, npm, or a compiler on the host; **Auto** remains the default. Standard Windows SSH accounts work, and keystrokes typed during terminal reconnection are kept.
- **Screenshot drops:** Mac screenshot thumbnails can now be dropped into a local Claude Code terminal or the new-workspace composer. Orca gives the agent a readable copy of the temporary image; previously, some drops looked successful but the screenshot never reached Claude Code.
- **Terminals and files:** macOS Option shortcuts reach terminal apps, background terminals return to their original tab, and wide paired-server panes use their full width. Huge Markdown previews no longer freeze Orca; review-note visibility and shell-file highlighting are fixed.
- **Stability and tools:** Orca recovers from several Linux and Windows crash loops and retries failed window launches. The first Windows browser command no longer hangs, the iOS simulator works with Xcode 27, and `orca file open` stays in your current view unless given `--focus`.

Terminals open before this update keep using the previous background service; new terminals use the new one.

## Known issues

**Windows on ARM:** The ARM64 package ships an x64 `orca.exe` command-line tool. Windows 11 on ARM runs it under emulation. Windows 10 on ARM can't run it, so the `orca` command does not work there (#24094).

**OpenCode 2:** OpenCode 2 panes that were already running before the update may show no status until you restart OpenCode in them. If you downgrade Orca after this update, duplicate OpenCode status plugins are left behind. After `opencode run` exits, its pane can keep showing "Done"; a fix is pending in #24472.

**Codex:** After you upgrade, Codex launches use Orca's managed Codex home until Codex approves Orca's new status hook. A resumed pane that uses `~/.codex` can pause for up to 30 seconds (#23552).

**Claude folder trust:** Folder pre-trust is on by default (Settings → Agents → "Trust the folder when Orca starts an agent"). On Alpine WSL, Orca can't copy the file permissions it needs, so Claude shows its own trust prompt instead (#23744).
